jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:

CityTeam is a Christian non-profit dedicated to supporting communities by meeting immediate needs and enabling lasting solutions for those struggling with poverty, homelessness, and addiction. Being part of CityTeam is not just a career but a calling. As ministerial representatives on the frontlines of our organization, we feel privileged to use our education, experience, and gifts to love people and bring glory to God.

A ministerial worker must be a Christ-centered individual who is active in a faith-based community, well-versed in Scripture, and passionate about helping clients grow in their relationship with Christ. In this dual role of spiritual guide and program manager, the worker provides spiritual direction, administrative oversight, and direct logistical coordination for individuals participating in our faith-based residential and recovery programs. The expectation for this role is that your daily life will serve as a living testimony to our program participants.

This is a Christian environment that values Teamwork, Accountability, Humility, Innovation, and Joy.

The Program Coordinator is an integral part of our team, providing structure, accountability, stability, and hope for those receiving services at CityTeam. This role is responsible for the day-to-day operations and logistics of our growing programs while serving as the go-to resource for clients, volunteers, and interns. Our ideal candidate is passionate about God’s transformational love, functions well under pressure, handles conflict with grace, and can pivot quickly in a fast-paced environment to serve as a living testimony to our participants.

This is a full-time, non-exempt position. Beyond salary, CityTeam offers a comprehensive benefits package, including Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance, Paid Vacation, Paid Holidays, Paid Sick Leave, and Retirement Benefits.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

**Spiritual Leadership & Ministerial Guidance**

* Devotional & Prayer: Facilitate and participate in daily/weekly devotional and prayer meetings.
* Biblical Guidance & Discipleship: Provide biblical guidance relevant to client needs.
* Spiritual Integration: Assist residents in identifying spiritual challenges, establishing daily spiritual disciplines, and seeking opportunities to encourage lasting life transformation through a personal relationship with Jesus Christ.
* Christian Witness & Culture: Model a consistent Christian lifestyle while cultivating a ministry culture centered on prayer, servant leadership, personal responsibility, forgiveness, reconciliation, and dependence upon God.

**Program Operations & Daily Oversight**

* Operational Coordination: Responsible for the day-to-day coordination of CityTeam programs under the direction of the supervisor, ensuring compliance with all operational policies and procedures.
* Scheduling & Facilitation: Schedule and facilitate program components, including discipleship groups, Bible studies, life-skills curriculum, and recreational activities.
* Client Supervision: Provide supervision and accountability for clients in all program areas, including general behavior, spiritual development, drug testing (UA) protocols as necessary, job placements, and program evaluations.
* Project Management: Manage multiple operational projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks effectively, and delegate responsibilities as needed to maintain smooth facility operations.

**Direct Services & Case Management Support**

* Case Management Assistance: Assist with direct case management services as needed, maintaining accurate, up-to-date case files and producing necessary program reports.
* Service Coordination: Collaborate with ministry staff to coordinate appropriate support services and maintain smooth transfer flows for all residents receiving services.
* Resource & Support Network: Serve as the primary go-to person for clients, volunteers, and interns to answer questions, resolve issues, and navigate daily program processes.

**Volunteer, Intern & Team Leadership**

* Coaching & Leadership: Provide spiritual leadership, biblically based training, and coaching to program subordinates, volunteers, and interns.
* Staff Strategy: Utilize effective leadership strategies to encourage spiritual growth, excellence, and biblical compassion among interns, volunteers, and program participants.

**Transportation & Logistics**

* Transportation: Provide safe transportation for residents essential appointments, off-site activities, and program events as needed.
* Supply & Errand Logistics: Assist with administrative errands, supply pickups, and program logistical needs.

**Administration & Other Duties**

* Reporting & Compliance: Maintain data integrity, compile operational reports, and track metrics as requested by ministry leadership.
* Adaptability & Special Projects: Respond to unexpected operational shifts with grace and a Christ-like attitude, performing additional administrative tasks and special projects as assigned by the supervisor.

Requirements:

**ELIGIBILITY QUALIFICATIONS FOR MINISTERIAL ROLES**

* Must have an intimate, personal relationship with Jesus Christ.
* Must be active in a local Christian body of believers and engaged in community with other Christ-followers.
* Must hold compatible theology with the major issues outlined in CityTeam's Statement of Faith.

**REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* Biblical Knowledge: Working knowledge of biblical concepts with the demonstrated ability to teach, lead, and model these concepts to the individuals CityTeam serves.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, Human Services, or equivalent combination of education and operational experience.
* Administrative Experience: Minimum of 2 years of administrative, program coordination, or operational experience.
* Technical Skills: Computer literacy with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel) or Google Workspace, and experience with database entry.

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas – Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease – we reach thousands of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science-based. If you have a passion for solving complex challenges and driving meaningful impact for patients, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team.

**HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?**

At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. As a global biotechnology leader, we collaborate across disciplines to deliver innovative therapies that reach millions of patients worldwide. It’s time for a career you can be proud of.

**Live**

**What you will do**

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world.

The **Patient Access Liaison (PAL)** is a field-based patient access and reimbursement specialist responsible for supporting patients, caregivers, healthcare providers, and sites of care in navigating insurance coverage and reimbursement pathways for Amgen therapies.

The PAL serves as a key resource in helping stakeholders understand payer requirements, prior authorization processes, reimbursement considerations, and available patient support resources. The role focuses on ensuring timely and sustained access to therapy by addressing reimbursement barriers and providing education to patients and providers on coverage and financial assistance programs.

Working within a collaborative field environment, the PAL partners with internal teams including Market Access, Medical Affairs, Advocacy, Marketing, Case Management, and Site of Care teams to support the patient journey. The role operates with independence in managing assigned patient cases and contributes field insights that inform broader access strategies.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Patient Access and Reimbursement Support**

* Serve as a resource on patient access and reimbursement for infused and specialty therapies.

* Assist patients, caregivers, and healthcare providers in navigating insurance benefits, prior authorization requirements, and reimbursement processes.

* Support the identification and resolution of access challenges, including coverage questions, prior authorization barriers, and denied claims.

* Provide education regarding coding and billing considerations relevant to therapy access.

**Patient and Caregiver Engagement**

* Develop relationships with patients and caregivers through phone, virtual, and in-person engagement.

* Secure written or electronic patient HIPAA authorization within assigned geography.

* Assess individual patient needs and provide education and resources that support access to therapy.

* Educate patients on coverage considerations and the steps required to obtain prior authorization.

* Provide information regarding co-pay assistance programs, national foundations, and free drug programs when appropriate.

**Provider and Site-of-Care Education**

* Educate physician offices and sites of care on therapy coverage pathways and reimbursement processes.

* Provide information regarding common prior authorization requirements, coding considerations, and billing practices.

* Support healthcare providers and infusion centers in navigating reimbursement questions related to patient cases.

**Access Issue Resolution**

* Investigate patient access challenges before and after infusion.

* Support physician offices and sites of care in reviewing denied claims and identifying potential next steps.

* Escalate complex or systemic reimbursement issues to appropriate internal stakeholders.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with internal stakeholders including Market Access, Medical Affairs, Advocacy, Case Managers, and Site of Care teams to support patient access initiatives.

* Coordinate with internal and external partners to ensure appropriate resources are available to support patient access.

* Share field insights regarding payer policies and reimbursement challenges.

**Compliance, Safety, and Operational Excellence**

* Adhere to company policies, compliance guidance, and applicable to federal, state, and local regulations.

* Ensure activities align with HIPAA privacy requirements and internal compliance guidelines.

* Report adverse events and product complaints through established pharmacovigilance processes.

* Maintain accurate documentation of activities and interactions in Amgen’s internal system.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Facilities
jobs.description:
The Judicial Council of California is accepting applications for the position of Project Manager, Facilities with the Facilities Services office.

Under the supervision of the unit manager, the Project Manager exercises independent judgment with the planning, design and construction of renovation and improvement projects of all scopes and sizes. Incumbents are also responsible for budget and schedule tracking, design management, and/or project administration. Workload and count will vary based on project complexity, but generally this position will manage 12-20 projects concurrently. Today, these positions are required to manage an average of 8.6 projects per year, with an estimated value of $5.6M approved by the Trial Court Facilities Modification Working Group. Work includes the necessary processes and procedures to develop and manage the execution of Facility Modifications. Facility Modifications (FM) projects include but are not limited to minor construction, tenant improvements, system and infrastructure renewal, and equipment replacement.

**The Judicial Council**
  
The Judicial Council of California is the policy setting body for the state court system and has constitutionally conferred statewide rule-making authority. This authority includes developing, advocating for, and allocating the judicial branch budget. A majority of Council members are California state justices and judges; however, the Council also includes lawyers, legislators, and court administrators.

By enhancing its role as a leadership, knowledge, and service resource for the judicial branch, the Judicial Council’s staff organization seeks to continue to evolve as one of California’s most dynamic public service entities, focused on improving access to justice for all Californians by innovating and responding to the changing needs of the courts and the public. As a government body charged with improving the statewide administration of justice, the Judicial Council has multiple offices with diverse responsibilities relating to court policy and operations. As employees of the council, every member of staff should view and approach their work as one Judicial Council with a public service mission that is greater than the sum of its parts.

The Judicial Council strives for work life balance and includes substantial vacation and holiday time. In addition, we offer an excellent benefits package including pension, medical, dental and vision coverage, flexible spending, up to $130 per month reimbursement for qualifying commuting costs, student loan forgiveness as part of Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), and retirement savings plans. In Sacramento, the office is located minutes from downtown, just north of Discovery Park. The San Francisco office is only a 7-minute walk from the Civic Center BART station.

The Judicial Council offers hybrid work arrangements for many positions. The successful candidate will be expected to work in person at the Judicial Council’s San Francisco or Sacramento office at least two days per week, based on their office leader’s direction, and reside in the areas surrounding these locations. To be eligible for Judicial Council employment and participation in the Judicial Council’s Hybrid Work Program, a prospective or current employee’s primary residence/remote work location must be in the State of California and within a 150-mile driving radius of their assigned reporting location.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* FM Development and Estimating
  + Develop detailed project scope for execution of FM projects.
  + Document scope and develop preliminary cost estimates documentation.
* Communication on FM Projects
  + Meet with court, county, contactors, and other customers to evaluate project needs and requirements.
  + Coordinate and hold FM project meetings to provide project status, coordination of schedules, and deliverables.
* FM Project Execution and Management
  + Coordinate building access and hours of services between court and county customers and FM contractors, subcontractors, and other support services.
  + Manage and participate in project kick-off meetings with all project stakeholders.
* FM Contracting
  + Develop RFP, RFQ, and RFI documents in accordance with the JCC contracting policy.
  + Develop and manage contract selection process and document appropriate award justification.
* Project Closeout
  + Develop individual project close-out requirements based on JCC guidelines.
  + Review requirements with contractors during initial site walks and project estimating discussions.

**Qualifications**
------------------

  

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
  
Bachelor’s degree, preferably in architecture, engineering, building engineering, or construction management, and four (4) years of construction/project management experience. An additional four
  
(4) years of professional experience as noted above may substitute for the bachelor’s degree. Or, additional directly related experience and/or education may be substituted on a year-for-year basis.

OR

Four (4) years as a Facilities Management Administrator with the Judicial Council of California or four (4) years of experience performing the duties of a class comparable in the level of responsibility to that of a Facilities Management Administrator in a California superior court or California state- level government entity.

LICENSING AND CERTIFICATIONS
  

* Valid driver’s license, as assigned.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager (Oakland, CA)
jobs.description:
Cross Country is looking for top talent to join our team! We are a market-leading, tech-enabled workforce solutions and advisory firm with more than four decades of experience helping organizations solve complex labor and operational challenges. Recognized as a Top Place to Work by U.S. News & World Report and a Most Loved Workplace by Newsweek, Cross Country is committed to quality and excellence in everything we deliver. We were also the first public company to earn The Joint Commission Gold Seal of Approval® for Health Care Staffing Services Certification with Distinction — a standard we continue to uphold today.
  
  
**BASIC PURPOSE:**  
The Sr Program Manager oversees day-to-day service delivery and performance for assigned PACE (Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly) program client. The role ensures accurate position management, timely caregiver and clinical placements, supplier engagement, and adherence to PACE regulatory and contract requirements. The Sr Program Manager serves as primary point of contact for client leaders and internal teams, driving fill rates, time-to-fill, and renewal/extension performance while maintaining exceptional customer service and compliance.
  
  
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**  

* Own end-to-end position management for center personnel (create, intake, update, close) in client VMS/third-party systems and CCH technologies; ensure data integrity for KPIs (fill rate, time to fill, renewal rate, aging orders).
* Conduct thorough order intake with Hiring Managers to capture scope (participant needs, acuity, language, geographic coverage, shift, licensure, EVV, transportation) for center personnel.
* Maintain standardized position note templates specific to PACE/home care requirements.
* Match and submit qualified candidates to open requisitions for center personnel; review all profiles for quality and compliance before submission.
* Meet or exceed MSO SLAs (e.g., review/drop/submit within 4 business hours) and document outcomes for all submittals, interviews, offers, extensions, and declines for center personnel.
* Serve as day-to-day liaison for PACE leadership, clinical managers, schedulers, and finance; provide frequent status updates on openings, pipeline, and barriers.
* Proactively call facilities/centers to update needs, confirm extensions/renewals, and address urgent or crisis coverage (e.g., hospital discharges, participant safety concerns, flu/COVID surges).
* Coordinate assignment details (start dates, shifts, geography, mileage/drive time, planned time off).
* Distribute requisitions to supplier partners; drive supplier engagement and accountability to achieve coverage goals.
* Partner with internal recruiting, credentialing, compliance, and payroll; use a team to solve coverage gaps.
* Mentor and provide day-to-day direction to support staff (Staffing Specialist, Site Coordinators, and Branch leads) on process, systems, and PACE nuances.
* Ensure submissions and assignments meet PACE and state home care requirements (e.g., licensure, background, TB/fit testing where applicable, EVV, immunizations, driver/auto requirements).
* Escalate and resolve quality or participant-safety issues in partnership with client clinical leads and internal QA.
* Maintain meticulous documentation in line with audit standards.
* Produce weekly performance reporting (fill rate, time-to-fill, renewal rates, order aging, supplier performance) for client and leadership.
* Contribute to Quarterly/Annual Business Reviews (QBR/ABR), operational calls, and presentations with data-driven insights and action plans.
* Monitor production of aligned associates; verify coverage/back-up during absences and escalate risks timely.
* Negotiate assignment specifics with internal/external stakeholders within approved rate/contract frameworks; confirm terms (rates, shift, location radius, EVV, expenses).
* Drive prompt resolution of disputes, fall-offs, and schedule changes; document outcomes and preventive actions.
* Retain and grow assigned MSP PACE accounts through consistent, professional service delivery.
* May be required to provide after-hours, weekend, and holiday coverage based on business needs, ensuring timely coordination of staffing and effective communication with PACE program partners to maintain continuity of care.
* Other duties as assigned

**QUALIFICATIONS:**  

* 5+ years of account or program management experience in healthcare staffing within an MSP/MSO/VMS environment.
* Minimum 3 years of leadership experience required, in healthcare staffing, homecare, or a related field. 5 years preferred.
* Experience supporting PACE programs or home/community-based care (HCBS), including knowledge of state regulations, EVV, and credentialing preferred.
* Solid sales/negotiation acumen (rates, extensions, renewals) and supplier management experience preferred.
* Demonstrated success managing multi-disciplinary home care or post-acute staffing (caregivers and clinical roles) with measurable KPI improvements.
* Strong customer service and stakeholder management skills; proven ability to lead cross-functional, matrixed teams.
* Proficiency with VMS/third-party client systems and Microsoft Office; strong Excel/reporting skills.
* Clear, professional communication (written and verbal); strong organization, follow-through, and attention to detail.

**Education:** High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor’s in Business, Healthcare Administration, or related field preferred or any equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential functions of the job.
  
  
Company equipment(laptop, monitor, keyboard, mouse headset) will be provided directly to you for use during employment.
  
  
Benefits
  
  
Cross Country offers a competitive compensation, benefits, and wellness program, including Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Voluntary Insurance, 401(k) plan, Tuition

jobs.description:
The role of the Member Service Professional (MSP) will be to deliver superior service to Card Members visiting the American Express Centurion Lounge, located in the San Francisco Airport. MSPs will be the face of American Express to our customers, acting as ambassadors of the brand. Working as a cohesive team, they will have the ability to excite our customers and deliver on the brand promise. A successful MSP within the Centurion Lounge will have a passion for delivering extraordinary service to our best Card Members, in a customer facing environment. Our MSPs are highly skilled and motivated, providing travel, card, concierge and lifestyle services to American Express Card Members. Acting as a consultant, our MSPs will tailor our products and services to assist Card Members with their immediate needs and deepening their relationship with American Express.

  

**A successful candidate will possess the following qualifications:**

* Minimum of 1-year recent experience servicing premium customers
* Airline, lounge or travel industry experience is preferred, including reservation experience
* Passion for servicing customers with proactive solutions
* Exceptional communication skills, delighting the customer with every single interaction
* The ability to listen to the customer’s needs, in turn offering confident recommendations, resulting in high satisfaction from the customer with the service they received
* Must exhibit the utmost professionalism and maintain a positive attitude in all interactions
* The ability to rely on and collaborate with your colleagues is essential, as the lounge is a very active, fast-paced, team environment
* Ability to make decisions quickly and effectively, when unanticipated situations may arise, putting the Card Members’ experience at the forefront of everything you do
* Must be resourceful and capable of using the Internet effectively while providing assistance in a face-to-face customer environment
* Ability to utilize and switch from multiple technology platforms with ease
* Adapt to an ever-changing environment and being resilient
* Ability to work flexible shifts including nights, weekends, and holidays is essential
Light to moderate lifting may be required for certain job tasks  

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

  

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need

We're on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we're building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

jobs.description:

Industrious is the largest premium workplace-as-a-service provider and home to the highest-rated workplaces in the industry. Everything we do comes down to creating great days for teams of all sizes and stages, including our own. We believe that what makes a great day at work is the people on your team and the problems you get to solve together. We’re looking for people who love thinking outside the box and thrive in a truly collaborative setting. As teammates, we encourage new ideas and toast every win. We’re excited about having a meaningful impact on people’s workplace experience.

**Great days also start when everyone can be their authentic self at work.** Diversity of backgrounds, thoughts, and ideas is critical to our success in delivering great workplace experiences, both for our members and for each other. Industrious is committed to creating an inclusive, respectful environment that embraces your individuality and quirkiness. You are valued for who YOU are. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team.

**To learn more, visit** **www.industriousoffice.com/careers****.**

Your genuine curiosity makes you successful at our consultative sales approach by uncovering and solving people’s needs. You pull together the most remarkable events and love the hard work it takes behind the scenes to make it happen. You love to help.

Industrious helps companies of all sizes find their office home so that they can do their best work. Our team is rewriting the book on productivity by creating a new workplace experience.

We are Industrious.

Extraordinary is no ordinary achievement. We’ll only make this dream happen with a team of considerate collaborators who don’t think inside the box. In fact, we don’t even see one. Come join our team.

**In a year you’ll know you’re successful if:**

* You can confidently identify companies' most important needs, enjoy being their tour guide, and deliver impactful solutions to them

* No member request is too big or too small for you to handle

The annual base compensation range for this role starts at **$73,000**. The successful candidate's actual base compensation will be based upon a variety of factors, including but not limited to work experience, job related knowledge, skills and professional qualifications.

Meta's Product Data Operations (PDO) team is looking for a Data Operations Program Manager to own workforce management for the in-house robotics data collection program. jobs.title: Pharmacy Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
  
Where state and federal laws/regulations allow, accountable for performing day-to-day non-clinical pharmacy operations, administrative activities; Ensures efficient pharmacy workflow and a positive patient experience. Serves as a full-time certified pharmacy technician. Responsible for operating pharmacy systems to obtain patient and drug information and process prescriptions. Under the supervision of a pharmacist, supervising pharmacy technicians and pharmacy cashiers within the guidelines of authorized company policies, laws, regulations and business ethics. Responsible for the selection, scheduling, and development of pharmacy technician personnel. Leads training, coaching, and performance management of pharmacy technicians. Makes decisions regarding performance management including discipline and termination.
  
  
**Customer Experience**

* Engages customers and patients by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. Resolves customer complaints, helps respond to customers’ requests in a timely manner and answers non-clinical questions to ensure a positive customer experience. Models and shares customer service best practices.
* Develops strong relationships with customers by anticipating customer needs and proactively offering services to provide the best experience possible when using the pharmacy. Enhances customer experience by increasing focus on healthcare services.

**Operations**

* Responsible for assisting pharmacist in the delivery of patient care including patient registration, prescription data entry, preparation of medications for patients, counting, and verifying (where allowed by law). Completes patient and physician calls under the supervision of a pharmacist (where allowed by law). Under the supervision of a pharmacist assists with healthcare service offerings including administering vaccines, health screenings, and any health services allowed by law.
* Within the guidelines of authorized company policies, state and federal laws/regulations, exercises independent judgment to delegate, direct, and assign non-clinical work in the pharmacy. Ensures tasks are completed on-time and holds others accountable for efficient workflow.
* At the direction of the Pharmacy Manager or pharmacist, prepares, and files reports and records required by the company and various government agencies.
* Manages core pharmacy workflow and drives excellence in pharmacy operations. Coordinates and organizes pharmacy daily schedule of activities. Recommends allocation of pharmacy hours. Assures the pharmacy is clean, neat, orderly, and stocked with adequate supplies.
* Under the direction of the pharmacist, exercises independent judgment to ensure compliance and execution of all business administrative activities and pharmacy inventory management tasks that do not require pharmacist licensure. Manages annual inventory preparation.
* Accountable for completion of non-clinical patient calls.
* Drives new technology/ process roll out, champions change and engages team around action planning. Assures proper operation and maintenance of pharmacy department equipment. In collaboration with Pharmacy Manager, responsible for recordkeeping and ensuring security safeguards are in-place.

Position Summary

jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

As an Airfreight Operations Manager, you must be capable of independently managing shipments from the initial customer request through quoting, dispatch, pickup, airline recovery or tender, shipment monitoring, documentation, and final delivery. This role requires an individual who understands both the operational and documentation sides of air freight and can make accurate, time-sensitive decisions without continuous supervision.

**Duties**

* Manage daily air freight and time-critical transportation operations. • Coordinate airline recoveries, airline tenders, pickups, transfers, and final-mile deliveries.
* Review customer shipment requests and determine the appropriate vehicle, driver, routing, and service requirements.
* Quickly reroute or switch drivers when delays, schedule changes, breakdowns, or other operational issues occur.
* Dispatch and route multiple drivers while considering location, shipment priority, airline cutoff times, vehicle type, and delivery deadlines.
* Prepare, review, and verify air freight documentation, including MAWB, IAC paperwork, airline labels, PPW, and customer-specific documentation.
* Understand airline cargo recovery and tender procedures, cargo terminal requirements, and cutoff times.
* Prepare accurate transportation quotations based on shipment requirements, mileage, vehicle type, waiting time, additional stops, and special handling.
* Monitor active shipments from dispatch through completion and provide accurate status updates.
* Communicate professionally with customers, drivers, airlines, cargo facilities, warehouses, and internal teams.
* Identify potential service failures and take proactive corrective action.
* Handle operational exceptions including airline delays, incorrect or missing documentation, missed cutoffs, driver issues, facility closures, and shipment changes.
* Maintain knowledge of customer-specific SOPs and shipment requirements.
* Review driver paperwork, proof of pickup, proof of delivery, airline tender documentation, and shipment records for accuracy.
* Assist in training operations personnel on airline procedures, documentation, driver routing, and customer requirements.

**Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in air freight, freight forwarding, airport logistics, courier operations, expedited transportation, or a related field preferred.
* Strong hands-on experience with airline cargo operations.
* Strong working knowledge of MAWB, IAC procedures, airline labels, PPW, and air freight documentation.
* Experience coordinating airline cargo recoveries and tenders. Page 1 NEONLINE LOGISTICS INC.
* Proven experience dispatching and routing multiple drivers and shipments simultaneously.
* Ability to understand shipment dimensions, weights, vehicle requirements, routing, and operational priorities.
* Experience preparing customer transportation or logistics quotations.
* Experience communicating directly with customers, freight forwarders, airlines, warehouses, and drivers.
* Experience with pharmaceutical, life-science, temperature-sensitive, or time-critical transportation is highly preferred.
* Previous supervisory, lead, or operations-management experience is preferred.

Pay: $80,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hayward, CA 94545

**Company Description**

XP Power is a major supplier of critical power conversion technology to the medical, technology, industrial, and defence markets. We are a fast-growing company listed on the London Stock Exchange. We are looking for self-motivated professionals who thrive in dynamic environments. We are proud of and committed to our culture that values Customer Focus, Flexibility, Knowledge, Speed, and Integrity. Joining our team means you will work in a high performing global company where employees collaborate and strive for excellence.

 **Job Description**

About the Role

XP Power is looking for an Operations Program Manager to lead the manufacturing elements of New Product Introduction (NPI) programs at our Silicon Valley site,. The role will also manage the deployment of key manufacturing process improvement projects as needed.

Our Silicon Valley team designs and builds custom power supply solutions for top companies in the industry including medical, semiconductor processing equipment and general industrial markets.

Programs here are designed/built under ISO9001 guidelines and have many moving parts during the Prototype/Pilot phases with the additional requirement of transferring the volume production from San Jose to Vietnam. Products can be classified as having medium-to-high technical complexity, short timelines, and high customer expectations.

This is a new role and requires a tight collaboration between Product Development Manufacturing Engineering, Production, and Supply Chain. Success means products reach customers on time, transfers go smoothly, and customers adopt what we build.

What You'll Do

Lead operations for NPI and manufacturing programs

* Represent manufacturing and operations on the NPI team. Own the operations plan for multiple NPI programs at once, from kickoff through production release, and take on manufacturing projects as needed.
* Partner closely with Development Engineering and the NPI TPM team in Engineering. Align on schedules, design maturity, and build plans, and bring manufacturing input into each program early.
* Build and maintain integrated schedules. Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and actions across functions.
* Push daily progress with manufacturing engineers, the production team, and supply chain. Remove roadblocks and escalate early when timelines are at risk.
* Re-plan quickly when customer requirements, designs, or priorities change.

Manage supply chain readiness

* Work with supply chain and purchasing to make sure materials, long-lead components, and supplier commitments support the build plan.
* Use SAP to track material status, shortages, and order progress. Drive recovery plans when gaps appear.

* Lead the operations side of moving products from NPI into production. Confirm that documentation, processes, tooling, test, training, and materials are in place before release.
* Define, standardize, and improve the handoff process so future NPI launches are faster and more repeatable.

Prepare product transfers to Vietnam

* With manufacturing engineering and production, plan and run transfer-readiness activities for moving products from Silicon Valley to our Vietnam factory.
* Build and track transfer readiness checklists, timelines, and success criteria. Coordinate with Vietnam counterparts so each transfer is well prepared.
* Travel to Vietnam as needed to support transfers.

Communicate progress

* Give regular, clear status updates to the VP of Operations, executives, cross-functional partners, and customer-facing teams when needed.
* Create and maintain program dashboards that show schedule, milestone, risk, and material status at a glance.

jobs.description:
**About the job**
-----------------

**Cuttable exists because creativity shouldn’t be what slows marketing teams down.**

The world’s biggest advertising platforms demand more ads than most teams can produce. But production is still slow, expensive and built for a different era. Briefs pile up. Creative teams burn out. Marketers can’t keep up.

Cuttable fixes that.

We’re an AI Creative Production System that helps ecommerce brands create, test and launch ads across Meta, TikTok and Google at the volume the platforms actually reward.

More than 300 brands across North America and Asia Pacific already use Cuttable. We're backed by Square Peg, Rampersand and AirTree, following one of the largest seed rounds in Australian tech history. Offices in Melbourne and New York.

Our CEO and co-founder, Sam Kroonenburg, has built and scaled a global technology company before. Now we’re doing it again.

**Join us and help make good ads, instantly.**

### **The role**

**Pay range: $98,000 – $147,000 USD per year**

Cuttable's US business is scaling fast, and we're standing up a dedicated Implementation function in San Francisco to make sure that growth doesn't outpace the experience new customers get. Right now, activation — getting a brand live and publishing ads fast — determines whether a new customer ever finds a winning ad and sticks around. That's this role.

You'll own the activation outcome for every new US customer: running onboarding from kickoff through their first ads live, working the day-by-day playbook that gets brands to 20 published ads within their first 14 days, and handing off a fully activated, confident customer to the Account Executive or Account Manager who takes it from there. This is a hands-on, implementation-led role, not an ongoing account management one, and you'll be one of the first people building it in the US.

We're not looking for someone who just runs onboarding calls and waits for customers to figure it out. We want someone who treats every account's first two weeks as the moment that decides everything after it: proactive, hands-on, and relentless about getting brands to value fast.

Done well, six months in:

* Your accounts are consistently hitting the 20-ads-in-14-days activation standard, and you know which accounts are off track before anyone has to tell you.
* Handoffs to AEs and Account Managers are clean — the next owner isn't starting cold, and nobody's chasing you for context.
* There's a real, repeatable onboarding playbook that didn't exist before you built it.
* Customers' first impression of Cuttable in the US is a great one, because of you.

### **Who we look for**

We hire for values as much as experience, because mindset carries you through the parts no job description can predict. Here's what that looks like day to day at cuttable:

* **Be Brave & Own It**: you take smart risks and you own what happens next, good or bad. You own the outcome, not just the intention.
* **Create Customer Magic**: you listen hard enough to get to what customers actually need, not just what they said.
* **Say It (With Care)**: You say the honest thing, directly, and with genuine care for the person hearing it.
* **Progress Beats Perfection**: you'd rather ship, learn, and improve than sit on something waiting for it to be flawless.
* **Work Hard, Laugh Often**: you take the work seriously. Never yourself.

We believe you'll succeed in this role if you have:

* Solid experience in Customer Success, Implementation, Onboarding, or Account Management within B2B SaaS — ideally with hands-on ownership of a defined, metrics-driven onboarding or activation motion, not just relationship management.
* The ability to run a structured onboarding process end-to-end: configuring a new customer's setup, running onboarding and activation calls with confidence, and reading usage data to know exactly which accounts are on track and which need an immediate intervention.
* You embrace AI and every other tool that helps you move faster. Great judgment beats doing everything manually.
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and would rather create the playbook than wait for one.
* You're genuinely curious and love tackling the messy, unglamorous problems that others avoid.

### **What we offer**

* **Equity:** If you're helping build Cuttable, you should own a piece of what it becomes.
* **Market-rate pay, reviewed annually:** The people building Cuttable's success should be rewarded as the company grows, with regular reviews to make sure we're staying competitive.
* **For our US team** we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental and vision coverage, as well as a 401(k) retirement plan.
* **5 weeks of paid time off (PTO / annual leave):** Your 5 weeks includes our team-wide festive season shutdown, so everyone gets a proper break together. No half-logging in with Slack open in another tab.
* **Your birthday off, always:** Because there's only one you. *Work Hard, Laugh Often* isn't just about celebrating the big wins; it's about celebrating the people who make them happen.
* **Paid parental leave:** 12 weeks at base pay for primary carers and 6 weeks at base pay for secondary carers. We're proud to help people build great careers at Cuttable while supporting them as they build and grow their families.
* **Offices in Melbourne and New York (and soon San Francisco!), with flexibility built in:** We like the people we work with, so we've created spaces worth showing up to. But we don't measure commitment by chair time—work from home when that's what the day needs.
* **A tech allowance:** AU$750 / US$500 to set your workspace up properly, wherever you're working from.

*At cuttable, we're building a team as diverse as the businesses we serve. We're an equal opportunity employer and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity, or gender expression, sexual orient

jobs.title: Patient Services and Consult Coordinator
jobs.description:
#### **POSITION SUMMARY**

The Patient Services and Consult Coordinator serves as the first point of contact for patients, families, referring offices, and visitors at the front desk, and as the primary point of contact for prospective patients from initial inquiry through the surgical consultation. At the front desk, this role manages check-in and check-out, patient registration, eligibility and benefits verification, scheduling, phones, and patient payments, keeping clinic sessions running on time. In the consult role, it reviews new patient inquiries, referrals, and intake submissions to confirm that required paperwork and documentation are complete; schedules consultations; and coordinates with providers, insurance verification, and financial counseling so that patients arrive at their consultation informed and prepared. Once a patient has completed the consultation and is confirmed to proceed with a surgical course, the coordinator completes a documented handoff to the Surgery Coordinator, who manages the patient through surgery scheduling, surgery, and postoperative follow-up. This is a nonclinical position; it does not include rooming patients, clinical assessment, triage, medical advice, medical decision-making, or tasks performed by medical assistants or licensed clinical staff.

#### **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Front Desk: General reception, front desk, and checking in patients responsibilities
* Consult Coordination: Serve as the primary point of contact for prospective and new patients from initial inquiry through completion of the surgical consultation.
* Consult Coordination: Respond to new patient inquiries, referrals, and intake submissions received by phone, email, patient portal, in person, or other approved channels within established response timelines.
* Consult Coordination: Explain the practice’s intake and consultation process, required documentation, general timelines, and what patients can expect before and after their consultation.
* Consult Coordination: Distribute, collect, and review intake packets, referral submissions, health history forms, financial policy acknowledgments, and the Notice of Privacy Practices acknowledgment for completeness, confirming receipt of required items such as demographic information, insurance information, identification, intake and consent forms, medical records, and letters of support or referral, as required by practice protocols and payer requirements.
* Consult Coordination: Identify missing, incomplete, expired, or inconsistent documentation and follow up with patients, referring providers, and outside offices to obtain it within established timelines.
* Consult Coordination: Route documentation requiring clinical review to the appropriate provider or clinical staff. The coordinator confirms that documents are present and complete but does not evaluate their clinical content or adequacy.
* Consult Coordination: Coordinate with insurance verification and financial counseling to confirm that eligibility, benefits, and any consultationrelated referral or authorization requirements are addressed before the consultation.
* Consult Coordination: Schedule, confirm, and reschedule inperson and telehealth consultations, and send appointment details, preconsultation instructions, and reminders.
* Consult Coordination: Serve as a liaison between assigned providers and prospective patients during the preconsultation stage for nonclinical questions, scheduling, and documentation needs.
* Consult Coordination: Conduct regular checkins with patients during the preconsultation period to keep them informed of outstanding requirements and next steps.
* Consult Coordination: Track each prospective patient’s status from inquiry through consultation, and maintain an accurate, current consult pipeline in the appropriate systems.
* Consult Coordination: Following the consultation, confirm the provider’s documented outcome and communicate nonclinical next steps to the patient.
* Consult Coordination: For patients confirmed to proceed with a surgical course, complete a timely, documented handoff to the Surgery Coordinator, including documentation status, any outstanding items, and relevant patient communication preferences.
* Consult Coordination: For patients who are not proceeding, or who must complete additional requirements before proceeding, communicate next steps as directed by the provider and document the patient’s status accordingly.
* Records: Scan, index, and file incoming records, faxes, and outside reports to the correct patient chart; route requests for release of medical records to the designated staff member in accordance with HIPAA, the California Confidentiality of Medical Information Act, and practice policy.
* Records: Accurately document patient communication, checkin and payment activity, documentation review, status updates, and completed milestones in the appropriate systems.
* Communicate outstanding requirements, scheduling changes, and next steps clearly and compassionately.
* Escalate complex patient concerns, documentation barriers, or operational issues to the appropriate department or leader.
* Protect the confidentiality of protected health information (PHI) at the front desk, on the phone, and in written and electronic communications, including when requesting and receiving records from outside providers; follow minimumnecessary standards and report suspected privacy incidents promptly.
* Provide respectful, compassionate, and genderaffirming support without providing clinical advice, medical education, or medical decisionmaking.
* Maintain regular and reliable attendance sufficient to meet the position’s operational, patientservice, and team obligations, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Comply with applicable laws, regulations, accreditation requirements, privacy and security standards, financial controls, and organizational policies relevant to the position.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Cuttable exists because creativity shouldn’t be what slows marketing teams down.**

The world’s biggest advertising platforms demand more ads than most teams can produce. But production is still slow, expensive and built for a different era. Briefs pile up. Creative teams burn out. Marketers can’t keep up.

Cuttable fixes that.

We’re an AI Creative Production System that helps ecommerce brands create, test and launch ads across Meta, TikTok and Google at the volume the platforms actually reward.

More than 300 brands across North America and Asia Pacific already use Cuttable. We’re backed by Square Peg, Rampersand and AirTree, following one of the largest seed rounds in Australian tech history. Offices in Melbourne and New York.

Our CEO and co-founder, Sam Kroonenburg, has built and scaled a global technology company before. Now we’re doing it again.

**Join us and help make good ads, instantly.**

### **The role**

**Pay range: $101,000 – $151,000 USD per year** — the range we reasonably expect to pay for this role at hire.

As Cuttable scales its US customer base, our customers need someone who owns their success long after onboarding. As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll own retention, adoption and expansion across a book of US customers from day 90 onward, including every renewal in that book. You’ll be the trusted advisor customers call for ideas, not just support, and you’ll treat retention and growth as your number, acting independently and never waiting for permission to save or grow an account.

You’ll report to the Customer Success Director and partner day to day with Implementation, Sales, Product and Support. This role is based in San Francisco, in the office at least 2 days per week (hybrid).

**What you’ll own**

* Product adoption and expansion (more brands, more users, bigger plans and more of customers’ spend on Cuttable creative) by tying Cuttable to the numbers they care about, like ROAS and CPA.

* Business reviews and success plans that make the value obvious to decision-makers at every level, from paid social leads to CMOs.
* Customer advocacy: referrals, case studies and champions inside customer teams.
* Smart prioritisation, so multi-brand teams and fast-moving single brands each get the attention that matches what’s at stake.
* Improvements to our renewal and expansion playbook, contributing what’s working in your book as we build the motion in the US.

**Who you’ll support**

* Implementation Managers, by agreeing a clean day-90 handover so customers never feel the change of owner.

* Newer team members, through informal mentoring, coaching and empathetic feedback.
* The Customer Success Director, with input on how CSM quotas and variable comp should be measured.

**What success looks like at six months**

* Customers are using more of Cuttable (more brands, more users, more of their spend on Cuttable creative) because you tied it to the numbers they care about, like ROAS and CPA.

* **Be Brave & Own It**: you take smart risks and you own what happens next, good or bad. You own the outcome, not just the intention.
* **Create Customer Magic**: you listen hard enough to get to what customers actually need, not just what they said.
* **Say It (With Care)**: You say the honest thing, directly, and with genuine care for the person hearing it.

* **Work Hard, Laugh Often**: you take the work seriously. Never yourself.

For over two decades, we’ve been at the forefront of the global energy transition, pioneering solutions that empower critical industries to thrive in a rapidly digitizing, energy-intensive world. From revolutionizing power for AI-driven data centers to ensuring resilience for hospitals, electric grids, manufacturing facilities, and utilities, our solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and solid oxide electrolyzer (SOEC) technologies are redefining what’s possible by delivering energy abundance for all. With more than 30,000 fuel cell modules deployed worldwide, we are the trusted partner for Fortune 100 companies and innovators alike. Our cutting-edge solutions enable unparalleled “time-to-power” capabilities, reliability, and sustainability, ensuring our customers remain ahead in a world where soaring energy demand and intensifying energy scarcity are rapidly becoming the new norm.

At Bloom, we thrive on collaboration, bold thinking, and relentless innovation. We believe that, together, we can create a brighter, more sustainable future while tackling the most pressing challenges of the 21st century.

  

We are looking for a **Customer Success Manager** to join our team in one of today’s most exciting technologies. This role will report to the **Director, Customer Success** and based in **San Jose, CA or Newark, DE. This is a fully on-site, in office role** .

**Role and Responsibilities:**

* Manage and track end-to-end Customer Success, with an emphasis on post-installation activities
* Proactively manage customer relationships for defined set of accounts, including QBRs and other key meetings, escalations, and issue resolution
* Act as primary customer point of contact for the Bloom Service team, and work cross-functionally with other Bloom teams including Sales, Marketing, Installations, Finance, and Legal
* Serve as primary customer contact and internal expert for long-term customer service and maintenance contracts (Contract Performance Manager role). Manage contract terms, scope boundaries, and issues, while ensuring customer satisfaction and execution per contract
* Understand key business drivers; leverage this understanding to successfully manage customer relationships and contracts / LTSAs (Long Term Service Agreements)
* Track weekly and quarterly metrics
* Manage customer reference process, in partnership with Bloom Sales
* Conduct various client surveys including annual NPS Survey
* Define and execute customer programs, and lead periodic training sessions
Leverage tools to assess customer site health, including Salesforce, Quickbase, and internal Bloom platforms  

**Skills and Experience:**

* 5+ years of energy industry experience, including LTSA management
* Client facing experience in Customer Success, Contract Performance Management, and/or consulting for a technology company a plus
* Strong educational background (Bachelor’s Degree), MBA and/or PMP Certification are a plus
* Experience with customer contracts / LTSAs, customer onboarding, and/or negotiations
* Previous experience in power generation services is a plus
* Outstanding analytical and communication skills
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple customers, projects, and work streams simultaneously and efficiently  

Bloom Energy is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We are committed to compliance with all applicable laws providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified applicants, will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability. Bloom Energy makes reasonable accommodations, consistent with applicable laws, for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified applicant or employee with a disability, who can perform the essential job functions, unless undue hardship would result.

Bloom Energy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The total compensation for this position includes standard company benefits and is based on various factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience.

The actual compensation package within the stated range will be based on a combination of factors such as an individual's skills, experience level, location, and other relevant job-related considerations.

  

**About Airbyte:**
------------------

We’re on a mission to make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. With 700+ connectors, our platform powers analytics and gives AI agents the business context they need to do real work. More than 25,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Airbyte to put their data to work.

  

We’re built on open source because we believe companies should have full control over their data. A community of 27K members helps shape what we build, and we’re backed by $181M from investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator.

Models keep getting better. What holds AI back is the data informing and shaping its decisions, and that's the layer we're building.

We’re just getting started. If you’re excited by big challenges, meaningful ownership, and the chance to help build what’s next, we’d love to meet you.

**About the Role:**
-------------------

We’re looking for a strategic, revenue-driven **Enterprise Account Manager, Growth** to drive growth across Airbyte’s existing enterprise customers.

You’ll proactively identify new opportunities across teams, workloads, and use cases, owning the full sales cycle from discovery through close. You'll also manage complex renewals, drive retention, and build executive relationships across a portfolio of strategic accounts.

You’ll partner closely with Sales Leadership, Customer Success, and Sales Engineering to maximize customer value, protect existing revenue, and drive long-term account growth.

This is a quota-carrying sales role focused on proactively generating expansion revenue, not a traditional Customer Success position.

  

**What You’ll Do:**
-------------------

* **Proactive pipeline generation:** Prospect within existing enterprise accounts, engage new stakeholders, and create new expansion opportunities.
* **Account Expansion:** Identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities across new teams, workloads, and use cases to expand Airbyte's footprint.
* **Full-cycle selling:** Own expansion opportunities from discovery and qualification through technical evaluation, negotiation, and close.
* **Enterprise renewals:** Lead complex renewal negotiations and commercial discussions to protect and grow ARR.
* **Strategic account planning:** Build account growth plans, map stakeholders, identify whitespace opportunities, and proactively manage renewal risks.
* **Value-based selling:** Build business cases that connect technical capabilities to measurable business outcomes and justify additional investment.
* **Forecasting and pipeline:** Own renewal and expansion forecasts, maintain accurate Salesforce records, and consistently deliver against revenue targets.
* **Cross-functional leadership:** Coordinate with Customer Success, Sales Engineering, and Sales Leadership to execute account strategies and support customer growth.

**What You’ll Need:**
---------------------

* 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, including at least 3 years in a quota-carrying enterprise sales role.
* Proven success as an Enterprise Account Executive or Enterprise Account Manager, with a strong track record of driving account expansion and revenue growth.
* Demonstrated ability to proactively generate pipeline, identify new opportunities, and expand into new teams, workloads, and use cases within existing enterprise accounts.
* Experience owning complex, full-cycle enterprise sales processes, from discovery and technical evaluation through negotiation and close.
* Strong strategic account planning skills, including identifying whitespace, building executive relationships, and developing account growth strategies.
* Experience managing enterprise renewals, retention, and complex commercial negotiations.
* Strong consultative, value-based selling skills, with the ability to engage technical and business stakeholders, manage pipelines, and forecast accurately.

**Nice to Have:**
-----------------

* Experience selling data infrastructure, cloud platforms, developer tools, or technical enterprise SaaS solutions.
* Familiarity with MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or value-based selling methodologies.

**What Success Looks Like:**
----------------------------

* Strong gross revenue retention and net revenue retention across assigned enterprise accounts.
* Consistent proactive pipeline generation and closed-won expansion revenue.
* Growth into new teams, workloads, and use cases within existing accounts.
* Predictable renewals with minimal last-minute surprises.
* Strong executive relationships, strategic account planning, and accurate forecasting.

**Location:**
-------------

* San Francisco, CA (Hybrid – 3 days/week onsite)

**Why You'll Love Working at Airbyte:**
---------------------------------------

At Airbyte, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to grow. Our market-leading Total Rewards package is designed to help you thrive professionally and personally. Our benefits and perks include:

* Flexible PTO with a culture that encourages at least 25 days off annually
* 16 weeks fully paid parental leave for all parents
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Professional development budget, conference sponsorship, and book reimbursement
* Commuter benefits and monthly internet reimbursement

* Breakfast and lunch in our San Francisco office

jobs.title: Manager, Strategic Account Management
jobs.description:
***Company Description***

*We’re**Checkout.com**. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.*

*We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.*  
  
*Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.*  
  
*If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.*  
  
*With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.*

Checkout.com is looking for a Manager, Strategic Account Management to own the growth, performance and long-term health of a portfolio of our most critical merchant relationships.

This is a high-impact opportunity for an experienced commercial operator who can build trusted relationships with senior merchant stakeholders, turn portfolio insight into sustainable growth and bring the right teams together to solve complex challenges. You will help Checkout.com become the partner of choice for strategic accounts through exceptional value, expertise and commitment.

You will be the voice of your strategic clients across Checkout.com, working closely with the Director, Strategic Account Management and partnering with senior internal stakeholders to unlock expansion opportunities and strengthen long-term partnerships.

**How You'll Make an Impact**
-----------------------------

* Portfolio strategy and growth: Own the strategy and account plans for a portfolio of strategic accounts. Anticipate merchant needs and identify opportunities to increase processing volume, net revenue, retention, share of wallet, product adoption and client value.
* Commercial ownership: Set account-level objectives, forecasts and performance indicators. Use data and commercial judgement to manage pipeline, renewals, expansion and risk across your portfolio.
* Senior client engagement: Build trusted, multi-level relationships with senior client stakeholders and functional leaders. Establish Checkout.com as a long-term strategic partner and escalate to leadership where relationships, risk or growth opportunities require it.
* Strategic planning and governance: Run account plans, strategic business reviews and joint planning sessions with merchants. Keep priorities, risks and opportunities aligned and actively managed across relevant regions and functions.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Mobilise Product, Operations, Legal, Risk, Finance, Data Science and other teams around your accounts' priorities. Lead coordinated responses to complex merchant challenges, remove internal blockers and improve the end-to-end client experience.
* Product, market and business influence: Bring structured client insight and market intelligence back into Checkout.com. Connect client needs, payments trends, competitive dynamics and regulatory developments to clear, actionable product and service recommendations.
* Team and leadership contribution: Share best practice and coach colleagues on account planning, forecasting and executive engagement. Support the Director in building consistent, scalable ways of working across the Strategic Account Management team.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Substantial experience in strategic or enterprise account management, customer success or commercial roles in a B2B environment, ideally within FinTech, payments, technology or another complex, high-growth industry.
* A proven track record of growing strategic accounts through retention, expansion, product adoption and long-term relationship development.
* Strong commercial acumen, including the ability to build account strategy, manage forecasts, interpret performance data and deliver against ambitious targets.
* Demonstrable experience engaging senior internal and external stakeholders and leading complex commercial discussions.
* Experience building and leveraging relationships across strategic customers, partners and the wider payments ecosystem to create opportunities for insight, collaboration and portfolio growth.
* The ability to move between strategic direction and detailed execution while managing multiple accounts, priorities and workstreams.
* Excellent judgement, problem-solving and influencing skills, with the confidence to lead through ambiguity and manage risk.
* Good knowledge of e-commerce, payments technologies, market dynamics and the trends shaping the industry.
* Experience mentoring or coaching colleagues is a plus.

**Additional Information**

**Bring all of you to work**

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

**Life at** **Checkout.com**

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Northern California
jobs.description:
**Project Manager**
===================

Onsite- Hayward, CA

### **Build Something That Makes an Impact.**

At AD/S, we bring ideas to life through custom signage, architectural features, displays, and fixtures that make a lasting impression. From illuminated landmarks that transform city skylines to wayfinding systems that guide people through airports, hospitals, resorts, and other major destinations, our work is seen and experienced every day.

We’re looking for an experienced Project Manager to join our team and take the lead on projects from contract award through final installation. If you thrive on managing complex projects, building strong customer relationships, solving problems, and keeping teams moving toward a common goal, we want to hear from you.

In this role, you’ll be the driving force behind project execution by balancing budgets, schedules, quality, and customer expectations while collaborating with our sales, design, engineering, manufacturing, and installation teams to bring each project across the finish line.

### **What You’ll Do**

* **Lead Projects from Start to Finish:** Manage all phases of assigned projects, including design, permitting, fabrication, delivery, and installation.
* **Own Budgets and Profitability:** Develop and monitor project budgets, track costs, manage margins, and identify opportunities to protect profitability.
* **Keep Teams Aligned:** Coordinate schedules, deliverables, and resources across internal departments, subcontractors, vendors, and customers.
* **Build Customer Relationships:** Serve as the primary point of contact, communicate project updates, resolve concerns, and deliver a high level of customer service.
* **Oversee Field Activities:** Conduct site visits and field investigations, assess site conditions, and coordinate or oversee installation activities as needed.
* **Interpret Project Documentation:** Review and interpret blueprints, construction drawings, specifications, and design packages to ensure project requirements are understood and executed.
* **Manage Subcontractors:** Obtain and evaluate estimates, negotiate pricing, and coordinate subcontractors for permitting, installation, and related services.
* **Monitor Progress:** Maintain accurate project records, track milestones, and report project status using company software and internal systems.
* **Manage Changes and Closeout:** Prepare change orders, project updates, and invoices while ensuring scope changes and costs are properly documented.

### **What You Bring**

* 5+ years of project management experience in the signage or construction industry.
* Strong ability to read and interpret blueprints, construction drawings, specifications, and design packages.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects, competing priorities, budgets, and deadlines.
* Excellent organizational, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* A customer-focused approach and the ability to build productive relationships with clients, subcontractors, and cross-functional teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Salesforce.
* A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset grounded in persistence, accountability, and integrity.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
* OSHA 30 certification is a plus.
* Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

### **Perks & Benefits**

We believe great work starts with a great team. AD/S offers:

* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance.
* Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays.
* 401(k) retirement plan with company matching after the qualifying period.
* Employee referral bonuses and discounts.
* A collaborative environment where craftsmanship, teamwork, and professional growth matter.

### **Why AD/S?**

At AD/S, you won’t just manage projects, you’ll help create the signs, structures, and visual experiences that make places recognizable and help people navigate the world around them.

Our success is built on craftsmanship, teamwork, accountability, and integrity. We take pride in what we create, how we work together, and the relationships we build along the way.

If you’re ready to take ownership, solve challenges, and see your work come to life on a larger scale, we invite you to build your next career chapter with AD/S**.**

**AD/S is an E-Verify Employer. All hires are subject to background checks and drug testing.**

jobs.description:
About Latham & Watkins:

Latham & Watkins is one of the world’s leading global law firms advising the businesses and institutions that drive the global economy. We are the market leaders in major financial and business centers around the world. Our investment in people, commitment to innovation, and focus on the future empower you to build an incredible career and thrive as an exceptional professional in a supportive culture. If you aspire to be the best, and work with the best, this is where you belong.

About the Role:

The Attorney Support Manager is an integral part of Latham’s Attorney Support team. This role will be responsible for organizing, supervising and developing Attorney Support staff in the Silicon Valley office, while establishing strategic and operational priorities for the Attorney Support team. This role will be based in our Silicon Valley office located in Redwood City. Please note that this role may be eligible for a flexible working schedule that allows for a hybrid and in-office presence.

Responsibilities & Qualifications:

Other key responsibilities include:

* Monitoring workflows and coordinating support assignments based upon daily firm and client needs
* Meeting and maintaining firm staffing goals by establishing effective and efficient assignments for attorneys and paralegals and recommending appropriate reallocations
* Coordinating with other department supervisors and managers regarding operational issues, and other logistical and resource requirements
* Working with coordinators and supervisors to ensure coverage for both planned and unplanned absences, while arranging coverage as required
* Making recommendations in regard to resource planning and recruitment needs
* Protecting and maintaining any highly sensitive, confidential, privileged, financial, and/or proprietary information that Latham & Watkins retains

We’d love to hear from you if you:

* Demonstrate excellent leadership skills (e.g. organizing, planning, problem-solving and decision-making) necessary for effective management
* Exhibit well-developed, professional interpersonal skills, and the ability to interact effectively with people at all organizational levels of the firm
* Possess the ability to work in a team environment with a strong customer service focus

And have:

* A high school diploma or equivalent, preferably a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* A minimum of seven (7) years of cumulative experience
* A minimum of five (5) years’ experience in a legal or professional services environment of relevant experience

Benefits & Additional Information:

Successful candidates will not only be provided with an outstanding career opportunity and welcoming environment, but will also be provided with a generous total compensation package with bonuses awarded in recognition of both individual and firm performance. Eligible employees can participate in Latham’s comprehensive benefit program which includes:

  

* Healthcare, life and disability insurance
* A generous 401k plan
* At least 11 paid holidays per year, and a PTO program that accrues 23 days during the first year of employment and grows with tenure
* Well-being programs (e.g. mental health services, mindfulness and resiliency, medical resources, well-being events, and more)
* Professional development programs
* Employee discounts
* Affinity groups, networks, and coalitions for lawyers and staff

Latham & Watkins is an equal opportunity employer. The Firm prohibits discrimination against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race (including, but not limited to, hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status (including veterans of the Vietnam era), gender expression, marital status, or any other characteristic or condition protected by applicable statute.
