jobs.description:
CLINICAL CARE MANAGER — JOB DESCRIPTION (External)

Title: Clinical Care Manager

Department: Client Services – ECM

Reports To: Client Services – ECM Manager

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Pay Range: $27–$38 per hour

Location: California | Hybrid

Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday; occasional extended hours as member needs require

Position Summary The Clinical Care Manager provides Enhanced Care Management (ECM) services to assigned members, including member engagement, clinically informed care coordination, assessment, and accurate documentation in alignment with payer and regulatory requirements. The role applies professional clinical judgment within the individual’s California license and scope of practice and escalates matters requiring additional clinical authority.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**ECM Service Delivery**

* Conduct outreach, engagement, and appropriate in-person and remote interactions with assigned ECM members.

* Coordinate healthcare, behavioral health, and community resources to support member needs and care transitions.

* Develop, implement, review, and update individualized care plans and assessments within licensed scope and established ECM workflows.

**Clinical Assessment, Risk Identification & Escalation**

* Identify clinical and non-clinical risks, barriers, and changes in condition; use appropriate professional judgment within licensed scope.

* Escalate urgent safety concerns and needs beyond individual scope according to established protocols; document follow-up.

* Collaborate with the interdisciplinary care team and appropriate clinical oversight resources.

**Documentation & Compliance**

* Complete ECM service documentation, assessments, and care plan updates accurately and on time

. • Address documentation gaps promptly and comply with payer requirements, privacy standards, and professional licensing obligations.

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Partner with Senior Care Managers, quality/compliance staff, providers, and operations teams to support continuity of care.

* Communicate clearly with members, families, and internal and external care partners. Required Qualifications

* Licensed clinician required – LVN, RN, NP, LCSW, LMFT, or equivalent (active California license required).

* 1–2 years of relevant experience in clinical care management, care coordination, healthcare, or a related field; a relevant BA/BS or graduate degree may substitute for the experience requirement.

* Strong documentation, organization, prioritization, and written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to manage multiple members and priorities while practicing within professional scope.

**Preferred Qualifications**

• Experience with California ECM programs and familiarity with EHR and care management platforms.

* Background in healthcare or social services serving complex member populations.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Member engagement and advocacy; clinical judgment within scope; risk identification and escalation.

* Documentation accuracy and timeliness; organization and follow-through; systems literacy.

**Physical and Work Conditions**

* Combination of office, remote, and field-based work; prolonged periods of sitting and computer use; occasional in-state travel

* Reasonable accommodations provided in accordance with applicable law.

**Workweek, Compensation, and Benefits** This is a full-time, hourly, non-exempt position. Omatochi offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off; holidays; and additional benefits consistent with company policy.

**Compliance and Legal Notices**

Omatochi is an equal opportunity employer. Employment is at-will and may be terminated at any time, with or without cause or notice, consistent with applicable law. This position complies with California pay transparency requirements

jobs.description:
Except in the case of an undue hardship, La Familia provides reasonable accommodations to persons with disabilities when the accommodations are necessary to enable the persons to perform the essential functions of the job. The Agency also provides reasonable accommodations when necessary based on religious needs. Individuals requiring workplace accommodations must discuss their needs with La Familia Human Resources. Individuals seeking accommodations for disabilities are typically required to provide medical documentation supporting the existence of a disability, the need for the accommodation, and what workplace modifications will enable the employee to perform the essential functions of the job.

**POSITION OVERVIEW:**

The Peer Case Manager will help clients navigate reuniting with their families. jobs.title: ERP Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Role summary**

We have an exciting opportunity for an ERP Implementation Specialist to bring Talon’s newly acquired West Coast manufacturers onto our standard JobBOSS² ERP. You will work alongside Talon’s current ERP Implementation Specialist and the IT Director, taking each shop from spreadsheets, QuickBooks or a legacy ERP to a standardized JobBOSS² environment, and making sure the team actually uses it. This is a hands-on, travel-heavy role: expect to spend 40–60% of your time on-site at shops located on the West Coast, mapping processes on the floor, converting data, training users and supporting go-lives in person.

The role is remote, and you must live on the West Coast (Arizona, California, Nevada, Oregon or Washington) within 30 minutes of a major commercial airport.

**About Talon Precision**

Talon Precision is a group of precision manufacturing shops serving the aerospace and defense, semiconductor, space and medical device end markets. Our customers help keep the world safe, connected, healthy and prosperous. Our mission is to restore manufacturing excellence here at home. Each Talon business operates with its own president and team, supported by a common Talon IT platform, including JobBOSS² as our standard ERP, so our shops can focus on making great parts.

This role is a key part of how newly acquired West Coast businesses join that platform.

**Key responsibilities**

* Carry out full-cycle JobBOSS² implementations: discovery, process mapping, configuration, data migration, testing, training, cutover and post-go-live support.
* Execute conversions from other ERPs (Epicor, Infor and others), including data mapping, cleanup, validation and parallel runs, with minimal disruption to production and shipping.
* Apply and improve Talon’s standard JobBOSS² configuration across quoting, estimating, job costing, scheduling, purchasing, inventory, shipping, quality and accounting integration.
* Work with operations, finance, quality and shipping teams to redesign processes around the standard, not around old workarounds.
* Help assess the ERP and business processes of acquisition targets and estimate integration effort, risk and timeline.
* Maintain project plans and cutover checklists, and report status and risks to the IT Director.
* Train site users and develop super-users who support their teams after go-live.
* Coordinate with outside resources (ECi professional services, conversion consultants) and Talon’s managed service provider to keep work on scope and schedule.
* Ensure ERP data supports consolidated financial and operational reporting across Talon businesses.
* Configure access and handling of ITAR-controlled and CUI data in line with Talon’s CMMC Level 2 program.
* Maintain implementation playbooks, templates and documentation so each new site goes faster than the last.

**Required qualifications**

* 3+ years of ERP implementation or support experience in a manufacturing environment, including hands-on work on at least one full-cycle implementation or conversion.
* Hands-on experience with at least one of: JobBOSS² (ECi), Epicor (Kinetic / E10 / E2 Shop System) or Infor (SyteLine / CloudSuite Industrial, VISUAL).
* Working knowledge of job-shop or make-to-order processes: quoting, estimating, routings, job costing, scheduling, purchasing, inventory, shipping and invoicing.
* Proven data migration skills: extracting, mapping, cleaning and validating data from legacy systems and spreadsheets (strong Excel; SQL a plus).
* Strong training and communication skills, with the credibility to win over shop-floor, front-office and finance users alike.
* Residence on the U.S. West Coast (Arizona, California, Nevada, Oregon or Washington) within 30 minutes of a major commercial airport.
* Willingness to travel 40–60% to sites located on the West Coast, with occasional trips to the East Coast, and to work early, late or weekend hours during cutovers.
* Ability to work on ITAR-controlled programs (U.S. person status required).

**Preferred qualifications**

* JobBOSS² implementation experience.
* Experience converting between ERPs, especially Epicor or Infor to JobBOSS² or similar.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, semiconductor, space or medical precision machining, or similar high-mix, low-volume environments.
* Experience integrating companies after acquisitions, or across multiple sites.
* Familiarity with AS9100, ITAR, DFARS and CMMC requirements as they apply to ERP data and access.
* Experience with QuickBooks or other accounting integrations, Power BI or ERP reporting tools.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Industrial Engineering or a related field.
* Project management certification (PMP, CAPM) or ERP vendor certification.

Compensation Range: $90K - $120K

jobs.title: Business Operations Lead
jobs.description:
### **The Bigger Picture**

At Andromeda, we're building the social intelligence layer for humanoid robots - technology that allows robots to understand people, build relationships and become a meaningful part of everyday life.

Our first robot, Abi, is already doing this in aged care and healthcare, where she brings conversation, companionship and engagement to people every day.

Now we're scaling from early deployments into a platform that can operate across thousands of real-world environments. We're looking for individuals who want to tackle hard problems across robotics and AI, and help define what it means for robots to live and interact alongside people.

### **About the role**

You'll be a high-trust generalist who works directly with the COO on the company's hardest and least-defined problems. One week you'll be standing up a new process for tracking Abi fleet health. Another week you’ll be automating a task multiple teams do by hand. And another week you might be standing up a new function.

You'll own projects end to end with a lot of autonomy and visibility. You will work across every function, from engineering and manufacturing to commercial and finance.

### **What you’ll do**

**Put AI to work on operations**

* Spot repetitive or high-volume work that AI can handle, then build, test, and ship agents and workflows (Claude preferred) that teams use every day.
* Turn what we learn from customers and operations into reusable templates and repeatable workflows.
* Be the go-to person for teams adopting AI tools in their daily work, and provide training and enablement.

**Give leadership a clear view of the business**

* Decide which numbers matter, then build and maintain the metrics and dashboards leadership uses to run the company.
* Support the planning rhythm: quarterly OKRs, leadership reviews, and the data going into board and investor updates.
* Dig into trends and anomalies to explain what is happening and why, and recommend what to do about it.

**Take problems from fuzzy to finished**

* Take ambiguous problems from scoping through business case, planning, execution, reporting, enablement, and impact tracking.
* Spot gaps, bottlenecks, and opportunities before they become obvious, and fix them with practical solutions as we scale.
* Step into whatever the business needs next, including work outside your comfort zone.

**Improve processes and drive adoption**

* Map how work really flows between teams, find the waste, and design simpler processes and tooling.
* Write down what you build so it outlasts you, and then train people on it.
* Roll out changes thoughtfully, check whether people are using them, and measure whether they helped.

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years in management consulting, investment banking, strategic finance, or business operations at a high-growth, start-up technology company.
* A track record of owning complex, multi-stakeholder projects to completion on tight timelines, with little supervision.
* Strong analytical foundation: comfortable pulling, cleaning, and modeling data (spreadsheets, SQL or similar, and a BI/dashboarding tool) to drive decisions.
* Hands-on experience building AI agents or workflows, ideally with Claude, and running and improving them in real use.
* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences, and the ability to influence senior leaders.
* High tolerance for ambiguity, context-switching, and intensity. Exceptional performance in whatever you've pursued.
* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business field, or equivalent experience. MBA or other advanced degree preferred.

  
**Benefits**

Andromeda Robotics is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. We are also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities.

The expected base salary for this role is $155,000 to $185,000 plus Benefits and Equity.

Please note: We do not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

**Our Values**

* **Empathy** – Kindness and compassion are at the heart of everything we do.
* **Play** – Play sharpens focus. It keeps us curious, fast and obsessed with the craft.
* **Never Settle** – A relentless ambition, bias toward action, and uncomfortable levels of curiosity.
* **Tenacity** – Tenacious under pressure, we assume chaos and stay in motion to adapt and progress.
* **Unity** – Different minds. Shared mission. No passengers.

**Let’s build the future together.**

This role requires a strong understanding of training program development, instructional methodologies, and competency-based assessments, ideally within autonomous vehicles, transportation, or other safety-critical operational environments.  
  
The successful candidate will have experience developing and managing structured training programs that prepare operational staff to safely and effectively perform operational responsibilities. This includes developing training curricula, establishing qualification and certification requirements, implementing recurrent training, and evaluating training effectiveness through measurable performance outcomes.  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for building and maintaining training programs that can be executed by Uber and its external fleet operators and staffing partners. You will work closely with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, and external partners to ensure training reflects vehicle capabilities, operational procedures, and evolving business requirements. This role will also support the qualification of instructors, oversight of training delivery, and continuous improvement of training programs as our deployments with our autonomous vehicle partners expand across markets.  
  
This is a highly cross-functional role requiring strong program management, stakeholder engagement, and the ability to translate complex technical and operational requirements into practical, scalable training solutions.  
  
**What you’ll do:**  

* **Training Program Development**: Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive training programs for autonomous vehicle operations, including onboarding, classroom instruction, practical evaluations, and recurrent training.
* **Curriculum & Instructional Design**: Create and maintain standardized training materials, instructor guides, learning objectives, assessments, and supporting documentation using established adult learning and instructional design principles.
* **Qualification & Certification**: Establish competency-based assessment criteria and qualification processes to ensure operations staff demonstrate the knowledge, skills, and practical abilities required to perform their responsibilities before being authorized for independent operations.
* **Training Delivery & Partner Oversight**: Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external staffing or fleet operations partners to support consistent execution of training programs, including train-the-trainer initiatives, instructor qualification, and periodic evaluations of training delivery.
* **Training Program Management**: Manage training program implementation across operational sites, coordinating schedules, resources, milestones, and deliverables to support fleet readiness, new market launches, and operational expansion.
* **Training Effectiveness & Continuous Improvement**: Monitor training performance through assessment results, certification outcomes, operations feedback, and operational performance data. Identify opportunities to improve training content, delivery methods, and operator proficiency.

  
**Basic Qualifications:**  

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in designing implementing training programs
* Demonstrated ability to manage training initiatives, coordinate multiple stakeholders, and execute programs against defined timelines and operational objectives.
* Bachelor's degree in Education, Instructional Design, Business Administration, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Minimum of 5 years of experience developing, implementing, or managing structured training programs in autonomous vehicles, transportation, automotive, logistics, or other operational environments.
* Direct experience developing or managing training programs for autonomous vehicle operations, test drivers, safety drivers, or other personnel involved in autonomous vehicle testing and operations.
* Experience developing and implementing train-the-trainer programs and overseeing training delivery through third-party vendors or staffing partners.
* Familiarity with training requirements and best practices in safety-critical industries, including automotive, aviation, commercial transportation, or autonomous mobility.
* Experience managing training programs across multiple operational locations, including supporting new site launches and geographically distributed workforces.
* A continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to adapt training programs to evolving technology, operational requirements, and business needs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience working across cross-functional teams and external partners to implement standardized processes and training requirements.

  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $162,000 per year - USD $180,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $162,000 per year - USD $180,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior People Partner
jobs.description:
### **About Niantic Spatial**

We are building for the >80% of economic activity that happens beyond the reach of screens. AI has learned from the text, images and video online, but it still lacks an accurate understanding of physical space. That's one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it's the one we're solving at Niantic Spatial.

We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That's why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world's most widely used maps. Now we're building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

### **The Role**

We are looking for a Senior People Partner who combines strong business judgment with hands-on execution. Reporting to the Chief People Officer, you will own People partnership for the business, with a particular focus on engineering and technical teams.

This is a player-coach role on a lean People team. You will coach managers and leaders, strengthen team effectiveness, and personally deliver the work required to turn decisions into action. On any given day, you might help a leader clarify team responsibilities, guide a manager through a performance issue, resolve an employee concern, or use AI to simplify a recurring workflow.

You will independently manage day-to-day People priorities, partnering with the Chief People Officer on broader organizational decisions and particularly complex or sensitive matters. You will also lead defined People programs and projects that support the company’s priorities.

You should understand how engineers work, build credibility with technical leaders, and bring practical experience helping teams perform through ambiguity and change. You are AI-forward in your own work and help others adopt better ways of working.

### **What You’ll Do**

**Partner with leaders to build effective teams**

* Translate business priorities into practical people plans for your groups, including staffing needs, team structure, manager capability, and development.
* Partner with Engineering, Research, Product, and other leaders to understand how their teams operate, identify barriers to execution, and improve effectiveness.
* Help leaders clarify roles, responsibilities, and decision ownership as priorities evolve.
* Surface emerging people and organizational issues early, recommend solutions, and follow through on agreed actions.
* Partner with the Chief People Officer on organizational planning and decisions with broader company implications.

**Coach managers and strengthen accountability**

* Help managers set clear expectations, give direct feedback, address underperformance, and recognize strong contributions.
* Coach managers and leaders on delegation, prioritization, communication, and leading through uncertainty.
* Guide performance reviews, talent discussions, and development planning for your groups, ensuring decisions lead to clear actions and follow-through.
* Help managers maintain a high bar for quality, ownership, collaboration, and speed.
* Build and deliver practical tools and guidance that strengthen everyday management.

**Execute organizational change**

* Help leaders plan and implement team changes, including role clarity, manager preparation, employee communication, and follow-up.
* Support the evolution of working practices as we move from technical exploration toward repeatable customer and business outcomes.
* Identify where unclear ownership, slow decisions, or unnecessary process is limiting progress and work with leaders to address it.
* Use employee feedback and people data to identify patterns, recommend specific actions, and assess progress.

**Own the day-to-day People partnership**

* Serve as a trusted resource for employees and managers, handling sensitive situations with sound judgment, discretion, and care.
* Manage employee relations matters and conduct investigations, partnering with the Chief People Officer and counsel as appropriate.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and hiring managers on role definition, hiring priorities, candidate assessment, and onboarding.
* Collaborate with Total Rewards on compensation, leveling, promotions, and retention recommendations.
* Own case management, documentation, and follow-through, bringing in additional expertise when needed.
* Contribute to the broader People team by sharing practical approaches and helping colleagues solve problems.

**Improve People programs and use AI to increase effectiveness**

* Lead defined People programs and improvement projects from planning through implementation, coordinating stakeholders and tracking results.
* Use AI tools regularly to accelerate research, analysis, drafting, and workflow improvement, reviewing outputs for accuracy and usefulness and exercising care with sensitive information.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work and create more capacity for manager and employee support.
* Help managers translate changes in AI capabilities into practical development needs and clearer expectations for their teams.
* Use HR systems, people data, and business context to inform recommendations and reduce manual work.
* Build processes that are easy to use and appropriate for our stage.

### **What You Bring**

* Typically eight or more years of progressive People experience, including significant experience as a People Partner or HR Business Partner.
* Direct experience supporting engineering

Overview:

GitHub is seeking an experienced and customer-focused Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinator to independently coordinate complex, high-risk and business-critical customer situations within the Incident Coordination team’s remit.

Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinator provides leadership during urgent customer-impacting incidents, creating clarity in ambiguous situations, establishing ownership and aligning Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Reliability Engineering, Customer Success and other stakeholders around a clear path forward.

This role requires excellent judgement, composure and the ability to influence without direct authority. The Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinator must be able to manage several competing workstreams, make explicit prioritization decisions and communicate complex technical situations clearly to customers, senior leaders and technical stakeholders.

The role extends beyond coordinating individual incidents. Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinators use evidence from incidents and escalations to identify recurring risks, recommend improvements and deliver agreed changes within the incident coordination remit. They partner with accountable teams on broader product, support-process and customer-experience improvements.

Success is measured through effective incident coordination, sound prioritisation, timely and accurate customer communication, reliable handovers and follow-through on agreed actions. The role also contributes to shared improvements that reduce repeat customer impact, avoidable urgent demand and preventable executive escalations.

Strategic incident leadership

* Independently lead complex, high-risk customer incidents, prioritising by impact, urgency and risk.

* Create clarity and momentum when cause, ownership, recovery path or customer outcome is uncertain.

* Own coordination, communication, action tracking and handovers across the incident lifecycle.

* Establish clear technical ownership and coordinate workstreams, decisions, risks, dependencies and next steps. Engineering and Support remain accountable for technical decisions, remediation and resource commitments.

* Exercise sound judgement, challenge assumptions and adapt the response as evidence changes.

* Make competing priorities and trade-offs explicit, engaging specialist support or accountable leaders when needed.

Cross-functional leadership and influence

* Bring together the required internal teams and Microsoft partners to coordinate an effective response.

* Align stakeholders with different priorities, responsibilities and perspectives.

* Influence technical owners, senior stakeholders and partners without relying on direct authority.

* Resolve unclear ownership, identify alternative paths and escalate proportionately while maintaining productive relationships.

* Drive timely decisions, confirm accountable owners and track actions, risks and dependencies to completion.

* Act as a trusted operational adviser during executive-visible and high-pressure situations.

Customer and executive communication

* Translate complex technical information into concise, accurate and business-relevant updates.

* Separate confirmed facts from hypotheses, risks and unknowns.

* Set an effective communication cadence and tailor detail to each audience.

* Avoid speculation, unsupported recovery estimates and unrealistic commitments.

* Provide coordination and clarity on customer calls, managing expectations and supporting de-escalation.

* Lead difficult conversations while balancing customer advocacy with technical and operational constraints.

* Maintain stakeholder confidence while protecting responders from unnecessary distraction.

Incident intelligence and repeat-failure reduction

* Identify recurring patterns and systemic risks across incidents, customers, products and processes.

* Use evidence to define clear problems, insights and recommendations.

* Lead post-incident reviews focused on ownership, prevention and operational improvement.

* Agree corrective and preventative actions, owners and expected outcomes with accountable teams.

* Track significant actions to completion, acceptance or formal disposition, escalating stalled or unowned risks.

* Evaluate whether improvements reduce repeat incidents, customer impact and avoidable escalations.

Organisational and operational improvement

* Lead incident-coordination improvement projects and partner with accountable teams to implement agreed changes.

* Use incident and customer-impact evidence to influence product, engineering and operational priorities.

* Improve coordination processes, tooling, ownership, communication, handovers and disengagement practices.

* Identify automation and AI opportunities that increase consistency, effectiveness and scale.

* Develop outcome measures that show customer impact, operational risk and improvement progress.

* Create reusable operating practices, clarify ownership and share learning with partner teams.

Capability building

* Build and apply expertise across incident workflows and relevant product areas to clarify customer impact and support investigation.

* Train and onboard coordinators, sharing judgement and learning from complex incidents.

* Review incident communications, handovers and escalations to improve quality and consistency.

* Create reusable playbooks, standards and guidance that strengthen team capability without creating dependency on individuals.

* Share learning with Support and partner teams to improve incident read

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Snappy Kraken is a marketing program leader in the financial services industry.

**We believe that our work helps people achieve greater freedom.**

* Our tools help financial advisors achieve greater freedom over their time.
* Our content helps people achieve greater financial freedom for their families.
* Our culture helps team members achieve greater freedom in where (and how) to live and work.

**Our innovative solutions set us apart.**

* Financial content is stale; we make it interesting.
* Marketing technology is complex; we make it simple.
* Financial advisor brands are bland; we make them captivating.

**The Purpose of This Role**
----------------------------

The **Rev Ops Manager** is a full-time, remote position at Snappy Kraken. *Accessibility requirements are dependent on the role but could be expected during standard business hours Monday through Friday.* This position is open to any candidates currently residing and eligible to legally work in the United States or Canada.

RevOps is a force multiplier at Snappy Kraken. When it works, people spend their time on the right conversations, risks show up early, and leadership trusts the numbers in front of them.

This is a generalist, hands-on RevOps role. You'll administer HubSpot and support the systems, data and reporting the team runs on.

We’re looking for someone who is curious. When a number doesn't add up, you can't leave it alone until you know why. You like a good puzzle: tracing a broken workflow back to its source, figuring out why a report and someone's gut disagree, untangling a setup nobody documented, following the numbers to recommend what growth levers to pull.

You also care about the people on the other side of the system. A clean routing rule matters because it gets someone to the right buyer faster. A good dashboard matters because a manager can coach from it. You measure your work by the team’s success.

**Reports to:** Head of Revenue Operations and Retail Sales

**Works closely with:** Teams across go-to-market, finance, leadership

**Primary Role & Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------

**Administer HubSpot**

* Serve as admin for the HubSpot portal: users, permissions, properties, pipelines and objects.
* Build and maintain workflows, sequences, lists and automation, and know why each one exists.
* Manage integrations between HubSpot and the rest of the stack. When a sync breaks, you're the one who finds out why.
* Document what you change and why, so the next person can follow your thinking.

**Support the teams leveraging Hubspot and its connected systems.**

* Maintain lead routing and assignment so every lead lands with the right person.
* Keep lifecycle stages, statuses and handoffs between teams working smoothly.
* Support attribution, territory and quota work with clean data and clear logic.
* Ensure clean customer data flows smoothly between all systems including Chargebee, Snappy Kraken, Hubspot, and others.

**Turn data into answers**

* Build and maintain dashboards and reports across the go-to-market funnel.
* Prepare recurring reporting for forecast calls and team reviews.
* Dig into the why behind a trend and bring a recommendation, not just a chart.

**Keep the data clean**

* Own day-to-day data hygiene: deduplication, standardization, enrichment and record ownership.
* Follow and help improve data standards across the CRM.
* Hunt down root causes. Fixing the record is good; fixing what created the bad record is better.

**Put AI and automation to work**

* Use HubSpot Breeze, Clay and Zapier to automate manual work and enrich data.
* Try new AI tools, measure what they actually save, and keep what earns its place.

**Help projects land**

* Run RevOps projects and support cross-functional ones from build through rollout.
* Sit with the people who use the system to understand how they really work before you build for them.
* Share what changed and train the team on new tools and processes.

**Primary Qualifications**
--------------------------

**The kind of person who thrives here**

* You ask "why" a lot, and you keep asking until the answer actually makes sense.
* You'd rather dig into a messy problem than work around it.
* You get genuine satisfaction from making someone else's job easier.
* You can explain a technical fix in plain words to whoever needs to hear it.

**Experience**

* 2–4 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or another go-to-market ops role, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* Hands-on HubSpot administration experience.
* A working understanding of the full go-to-market funnel, from first touch through renewal.
* Experience building dashboards and reports people actually use.
* Practical AI proficiency: you use AI tools regularly and have built real workflows with them.
* Familiarity with tools like Zapier, Clay and HubSpot Breeze.
* Experience cleaning and maintaining CRM data.
* Organized enough to run a project and keep people in the loop.
* HubSpot certifications.
* Experience with billing systems, call recording tools or data enrichment tools.
* Comfort with SQL, advanced spreadsheets or a BI tool.
* Experience in financial services or wealth management.
* Experience working in project management tools.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Work Remotely
* Personal Days for when you need a break (on top of your regular vacation)
* Development Fund to help you grow
* Medical Insurance Options
* Parental/Maternity Leave
* Growth opportunities

Pay will be based on several factors, such as experience, certifications, location, market conditions, and other business and organizational needs. jobs.description:
**Description**

Risk Financing sits at the center of how Liberty Mutual transfers risk to the reinsurance market, and its effectiveness depends on a large number of functions moving in step. This role exists to make that happen. As Reinsurance Operations Manager, you will be the connective tissue between Risk Financing and its key partner functions — Enterprise Risk Management, RI Operations, RI Accounting, Legal, Tax, LM Re and the broker community — ensuring that priorities are clearly set, actively managed and consistently executed across all of them.

This is a role for someone who is energized by turning recurring friction into durable process. You will own the definition of the treaty lifecycle and its implementation across the team, contribute to the standard operating procedures that allow placement teams to act with confidence, and take a leading role in renewal preparation and management — including the treaty handover to downstream teams within agreed service levels. You will work across the full lifecycle, from market approval and reinsurer governance through binding, post-placement data delivery and in-force management.

Much of the work involves shaping the agenda of teams you do not manage, so the ability to build credibility, communicate with clarity in writing and in person, and hold a position under senior scrutiny is central to success.

**What you'll do**

* Serve as a key operational point of contact between Risk Financing and its partner functions, establishing and maintaining a governed cadence with each
* Own the treaty lifecycle definition end to end and drive its adoption across the Risk Financing team
* Author, secure approval for and implement standard operating procedures and standardized templates that remove ambiguity and reduce duplication of work
* Own operational renewal preparation and management for reinsurance cycles, including new process implementation, training, and monitoring of operational handovers to Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and RI Operations withing tight SLAs
* Partner with ERM on reinsurer governance, collateral requirements, approved market lists and concentration frameworks, and implement approved changes as business as usual
* Support regulatory and control processes including SSAP62 risk transfer reviews, transfer pricing documentation and internal audit requests
* Drive data quality and standardization initiatives with internal teams and external delivery partners
* Identify and champion opportunities to simplify how the team delivers, including responsible adoption of GenAI tooling

At least 75% of time is spent on a combination of the following responsibilities:

* **Operational excellence and SOP ownership:** Own, maintain and continuously improve Risk Financing standard operating procedures across the treaty lifecycle, ensuring processes are clearly documented, scalable, audit ready and consistently applied globally.
* **Process optimization and waste reduction:** Identify inefficiencies, duplication and bottlenecks across Risk Financing operations, applying continuous improvement methods to simplify processes, reduce manual effort, minimize rework and shorten cycle times.
* **Automation and simplification:** Lead workflow simplification initiatives in partnership with Technology, Data and operational teams, translating strategic priorities into practical improvements.
* **Data, reporting and insight:** Improve data quality, lineage and usability across reinsurance systems and reporting outputs, using descriptive analytics, visualization tools, KPIs and operational metrics to support decision making and executive reporting.
* **Stakeholder and partner connectivity:** Act as a central coordinator between Risk Financing and partner functions including Finance, Claims, Actuarial, Legal, Tax, brokers and reinsurers, ensuring smooth handoffs, clear ownership and aligned timelines.
* **Governance, controls and risk management:** Support operational risk identification and remediation, ensuring controls, documentation and governance are in place to meet internal, audit and regulatory expectations.
* **Operational performance management:** Develop, update and analyze complex metrics used to assess operational performance, productivity, staffing needs, service levels and other measures valuable to Risk Financing leadership.
* **Audit, review and senior forum support:** Prepare materials, insights and recommendations for audits, reviews, governance meetings and senior forums
* **Innovation and continuous improvement:** Champion new tools, ways of working and data-driven practices across Risk Financing Operations, embedding continuous improvement into daily management.
* **Mentoring and capability building:** Provide guidance, coaching and mentoring to less experienced staff, helping embed consistent operational practices across the Risk Financing team.

**Qualifications**

* Competencies typically acquired through a Bachelor`s degree or equivalent experience in addition to 8+ years of relevant experience to include reinsurance operations, process improvement, accounting or audit
* Substantial experience in reinsurance operations, treaty administration or a closely related insurance operations discipline
* Advanced degree preferred
* Displays strong research, problem solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills
* Advanced business operations knowledge to include understanding the function`s value chain and market conditions
* Advanced influencing, relationship management & presentation skills
* Highly skilled at supporting change and imparting value within an organization
* Strong project management skills as part of implementing business process changes
* Advanced knowledge of available data sources, strengths and shortcomings

jobs.description:
Pathways 2 Solutions, Inc. (Pathways) is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business helping government and commercial clients turn complex challenges into practical solutions. Our capabilities span strategic communications, technology, training, program management, and organizational improvement. We bring together experienced professionals who combine creative thinking with disciplined execution to help clients achieve measurable results.  
  
We help clients develop programs, introduce new technologies, engage stakeholders, and equip people with the knowledge and resources to succeed. Our work with the Department of Veterans Affairs supports initiatives that improve the Veteran experience. We welcome professionals who bring sound judgment, fresh ideas, and a commitment to delivering useful, reliable work.

**Position Overview**
=====================

The Sprint Pod Project Coordinator provides day-to-day project coordination and operational support to a multidisciplinary team supporting VA’s Digital and Remote Health Center for Innovation. The Project Coordinator provides the organizational structure and dependable follow-through needed for effective sprint pod operations.  
Working under the direction of the Pod Lead, the Coordinator keeps schedules, task boards, meeting records, deliverable trackers, and project documentation accurate and current. The role helps innovation, implementation, technical, communications, and evaluation personnel stay coordinated as they support digital and remote health initiatives. The position translates approved plans and team decisions into maintained schedules, documented actions, organized records, and clear status information.  
  
This is a support position with no formal supervisory responsibility. The Coordinator helps the team maintain visibility into its work, identifies gaps and overdue actions, and brings issues to the Pod Lead for resolution.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
===============================

* Develops and maintains the standard tools and templates for pod use across all projects.
* Runs the pod's sprint mechanics — cadence, tracking, action capture, and follow-through — and maintains the record of acceptance criteria agreed at the start of each sprint.
* Compiles pod velocity data and support the Pod Lead in reporting against the ±15% tolerance.
* Supports development of Project Charters and Project Plans for assigned projects.
* Produces project-level change management, communications, and training support materials in coordination with the program-level Communications Specialist and Training Plan Specialist.
* Coordinates onboarding of innovators and pilot teams to the DRHCI process, using the pilot team guidebook.
* Maintains the project central repository content for assigned projects — documentation, FAQs, templates, and contact points.
* Coordinates meeting and workshop logistics for the pod, including with innovators, vendors, and site participants.
* Maintains project phase tracking inputs and supports the shared tracking system with DHO.
* Supports pod reporting to the DRHCI Program Manager and to VA, assembling status inputs from across the pod.

**Leadership and Collaboration Expectations**
=============================================

The Coordinator is expected to be proactive, tactful, organized, and dependable. Success requires asking clear questions, maintaining accurate records, following up respectfully, and communicating concerns early.  
The position supports the Pod Lead and team members by coordinating information and activities. Project priorities, task commitments, staffing decisions, scope changes, and final deliverable approvals remain with designated leadership and authorized personnel.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Three or more years in project coordination or project support on client-facing delivery teams.
* Demonstrated experience running the mechanics of a sprint or iterative delivery cadence tracking, status, action follow-through, and documentation.
* Experience developing and maintaining standard templates and tools that other people use consistently.
* Experience producing communications or training support materials for a project audience.
* Strong organizational skills and written communication; reliable follow-through without prompting.
* Ability to obtain a VA background investigation or public trust determination.
* Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders in a client-facing environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
* Ability to learn and maintain approved project tracking platforms.
* Ability to work independently within established priorities while recognizing when questions or decisions require escalation.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience supporting agile, sprint-based, Kanban, or comparable team workflows.
* Familiarity with backlogs, work-item estimates, sprint progress reporting, and review or retrospective activities.
* Experience supporting healthcare innovation, digital health, telehealth, remote monitoring, or technology implementation projects.
* Experience coordinating deliverable review and approval processes.
* Familiarity with project tracking tools such as Microsoft Planner, Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, or comparable platforms.
* Experience supporting distributed teams, multiple implementation sites, or government stakeholders.
* Experience supporting VA, another federal healthcare organization, or Veteran-facing programs.
* Relevant project management or agile training.

**Credentials and VA Experience**
=================================

No professional certification or prior VA experience is required.  
Relevant training or certification in implementation science, project management, change management, human-centered design, Lean Six Sigma, or quality improvement is preferred.

jobs.description:
**About Diversified:**  
Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  
**What to Expect:**  
At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.
  
  
**How You’ll Contribute:**  
Project manager (PM) is responsible for the scope, schedule, cost, quality and client satisfaction of a project throughout its entire lifecycle, from Initiating through Closing phases. However, the PM depends on the help of other people to perform most of the actual activities of the project. A project manager’s role is primarily focused around written and verbal communication to all project stakeholders.
  
  
The PM is responsible for overseeing, and performing project management functions on all M&E projects, budgets and scopes. The PM will act as the person responsible on their assigned projects and have direct control over all project activities.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**  
**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Daily activities include project communications, scheduling, task lists for technicians, managing deliverables from engineering, CAD and Programming and overseeing the completion of projects. The PM is responsible for completing systems integration projects on time, on budget and achieving high customer satisfaction from our customers. The majority of this employee's time will be spent managing projects and communicating with all project stakeholders. This person will be helping to constantly improve the established Diversified processes.
* As the primary interface to the client, the project manager develops a strong long-term relationship. He manages the client relationship, including expectations, communications and satisfaction.
* Coordinates and communicates.
* Provides clear leadership and ownership for the project within Diversified, including accurate and timely verbal and written communication and follow up.
* Coordinates all activities associated with the timely, accurate and on-budget completion of the project, including engaging stakeholders, delegating responsibilities clearly and running client and internal project meetings.
* Provides support and assistance to team members as needed in order help them be successful and get the job done.
* Ensures appropriate and frequent communication between stakeholders. Resolves destructive conflict.
* Designs, plans, and coordinates work teams with regard to M&E installation projects.
* Assumes ownership of individual projects and assignments.
* Establishes and maintains communication with Account Executives, Directors, installation technicians, subcontractors, clients, etc.
* Develops and communicates project updates as required.
* Provides constant monitoring of labor, equipment and materials budgets.
* Provides and/or directs technical and administrative support to project team members.
* Develops and maintains all related project schedules.
* Performs field verification of prospective work site. Documents all issues with site and keeps everyone informed of potential issues and solutions.
* Coordinates all drawings and documentation between all internal and external stakeholders.
* Facilitates and directs design reviews to assure proper documentation in the field.
* Coordinates all system programming and final checkout of systems. Provides punch-list of remaining tasks after substantial completion.
* Contracts with contractors and other trades when necessary.
* Monitors status of projects including cost, timing and staffing to ensure timely and accurate completion of projects.
* Ensures quality and continuous improvement.
* Coordinates training & turnover of projects to client, service department, & sales.

**Complexity:**  

* Every project is different, and every set of project stakeholders is different. The PM needs to negotiate a very complex set of variables between system design, site conditions and a widely varying set of expectations with multiple stakeholders. The skill of communicating both verbally and in writing to manage all these variables takes a very high level of awareness, emotional intelligence and people management skills. The PM is constantly managing the forces of change in every project environment. Balancing schedules, budgets, scope, quality and client satisfaction are a very complex set of variables.

**Decision Making Authority:**  

* Takes full ownership of project.
* Acts as the single point of responsibility and accountability for the project.
* Ensures schedule performance, quality of solution delivered to client, and client satisfaction.
* Manages and reports on the project’s financials, including ensuring budget performance and profitability. Ensures timely and correct billings to client.
* Demonstrates proactivity, responsiveness, and follow through.
* Communicates decision options to stakeholders and manages those decisions.
* Manages a complex array of decisions at every point of the project but is rarely the sole decision maker.

**Department: School of Law**

**Summary:** Perform a variety of highly responsible and confidential administrative and project management and coordinating duties in support of the Dean of the School of Law and other senior staff as needed.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Administrative support for the dean will include maintaining the dean's complex calendar and official correspondence; professional memberships; establishing and maintaining electronic and hard copy file systems; coordinating travel planning; drafting memos, reports, grant requests, and proposals as needed; maintaining documents, confidential files and faculty tenure records; and reconciling the dean's corporate account and monthly expense reimbursements. Provide project and event support, including drafting communications to potential speakers, preparing electronic event invitations, setting up registration sites, coordinating requests for financial and community sponsors, making logistical arrangements, and developing event budgets.  
  
Serve as a project manager on behalf of the dean, facilitating and coordinating initiatives and programs between university and law school departments, faculty committees, and others. Draft and synchronize communications from the dean for internal and external audiences across multiple platforms. Work closely with University Advancement on tracking alumni engagement and co-coordinating events.
  
  
Coordinate faculty meetings, including but not limited to notifying faculty and guests; communicating with faculty committees; distributing and maintaining records of meeting materials; taking and transcribing meeting minutes; arranging for meeting space, A/V and catering. Coordinate monthly staff meetings including preparing the agenda.  
  
Maintain State Bar of California, AALS, WASC accreditation files, bar exam records, and internal committees' files and correspondence for the law school; maintain subscriptions and communications from the ABA and other legal education entities; distribute information to law faculty and administration as well as university administration as appropriate.
  
  
Assist with special projects for faculty and deans. Serve as a liaison to the Law School Dean's Advisory Board, Law School Task Force, high profile alumni, members of the judiciary and other external stakeholders on behalf of the dean with the highest level of professionalism. Prepare formal reports and assist in the production of a variety of print and electronic communications as required by the dean.  
  
Maintain records of approved faculty travel; reconcile approvals to posted fiscal activity.
  
  
Publish and keep current law school directories, group e-mail lists and executive calendars. Ensure national and regional law school related contact information is kept current. Maintain and supervise the use of the Dean's Conference Room and related facilities.
  
  
Recommend organizational and procedural changes affecting administrative activities.  
  
Provide back-up coverage for the dean's suite front desk as needed.

Bachelor's degree required. Five years of increasing responsibility in office management within a non-profit or educational setting is ideal. Prior experience as an executive assistant required. Experience in a university academic administrative environment is preferred..  
  
Outstanding written and oral communication skills in English and sophisticated interpersonal skills required  
  
Excellent administrative and organizational skills; ability to plan, manage, and execute projects and events of various sizes from inception to completion with keen attention to detail.  
  
Sound knowledge of principles, methods and practices of electronic and hard copy record keeping and report writing. Knowledge of modern office practices, procedures, and equipment. Competence in use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in office settings is desired.  
  
Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment in relation to all forms of communication and problem solving.  
  
High level knowledge of the full Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, is required. Familiarity with social networking sites such as LinkedIn is desirable. Knowledge of the Brightspace platform, Doodle, and Eventbrite are helpful.

**About Willow Health**
-----------------------

In the United States, one in five adults experience a mental health illness and over 12 million people have thoughts of suicide. Mental health crises can be some of the most difficult times in a person’s life, and over 17 million people seeking behavioral health care experience a delay in accessing care. Willow Health is on a mission to significantly improve this experience by expanding affordable access to high-quality, evidence-based intensive behavioral health care. In order to make this mission a reality, we deliver a virtual, urgent crisis care program that provides personalized, recovery-oriented care for people experiencing behavioral health crises.

Willow Health offers patients immediate access to evidence-based virtual crisis psychotherapy, medication management, certified peer coaching, care management, and around the clock crisis coverage, while working to connect patients to the most appropriate next level of care.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

Willow Health has launched its virtual behavioral health program in North Carolina and is preparing to open an in-person location where patients can see a clinician virtually. This role will lead implementation of the physical site and manage ongoing operational workstreams, including partner reporting and invoicing requirements.

A substantial part of the role will involve working closely with the Joint Operating Committee consultant to coordinate site readiness, track deliverables, and resolve implementation challenges. jobs.description:
**About BRAINS**  
BRAINS is an independent creative agency and proud B-Corp. We're a group of no-a\*\*hole, roll-up-our-sleeves creatives, united by a mission to spark market and cultural impact and connect people around shared values and passions. We partner with mission-driven brands looking to rethink and rewrite industry norms.

### **Project Manager (Contract-to-Hire)**

**Reports to:** Creative Ops Lead  
**Direct Reports:** None  
**Position Type:** Contract-to-hire. 3 month contract with the intent to convert to a full-time role  
**Classification:** 1099 contract employee of BRAINS  
**Schedule:** Starting part time at 20-30 hours per week  
**Location:** Remote

**About the Role**  
The Project Manager runs day-to-day project operations, coordinating cross-functional teams and ensuring deliverables meet client expectations on time and within budget. This is an agency role: you'll manage several client projects at once in a fast-moving, client-service environment, so prior agency experience is required. The primary focus of this role will be a high-volume retainer client with a variety of task types and workstreams. The role starts as a 3-month contract, and we plan to convert it to a full-time position at BRAINS for the right person.  
  
***Due to client and team, candidates in the Pacific Time zone are strongly preferred for this position.***

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Leadership & Delivery**

* Create and maintain project timelines and scopes of work.
* Define clear project plans, track milestones, and anticipate risks to ensure smooth delivery.
* Monitor progress and escalate risks/issues as needed.
* Lead status meetings and project check-ins.
* Maintain visibility across multiple workstreams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with agency quality standards.

**Team Operations & Collaboration**

* Manage resourcing across assigned projects, ensuring workloads are balanced.
* Facilitate communication between account, creative, and production teams.
* Partner closely with account leads, strategists, and creatives to align project delivery with strategic objectives.
* Identify and escalate blockers for assigned project teams, ensuring momentum and accountability throughout the lifecycle of a project.

**Budgeting & Reporting**

* Collaborate closely with account leads to align on budgets and schedules.
* Track and report on project performance metrics.

**Who You Are**

* **A Systems Thinker**  
  You’re fluent in designing workflows that balance structure with flexibility and know how to keep teams aligned and focused.
* **An Operational Strategist**  
  You understand how delivery, process, and planning intersect with business health, client satisfaction, and creative excellence.
* **A Skilled Communicator**  
  You bring clarity, empathy, and precision to how you communicate, whether with clients, internal teams, or team leadership.
* **A Confident Problem-Solver**  
  You stay calm under pressure and have a knack for untangling complexity, resolving issues, and keeping momentum.

**Experience**

* **Required:** 3–5 years of agency project management experience, ideally in a creative/advertising environment. In-house or brand-side project management experience alone won't be a fit for this role.
* Hands-on experience running agency client work: scopes of work, retainer and project budgets, client approvals, and creative review rounds across multiple accounts at once.
* Advanced knowledge of project management tools. BRAINS uses Asana for project management.
* Strong understanding of creative processes (digital, motion, print, production, etc.).
* Excellent multitasking, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills.

**Contract-to-Hire Details**

* **Initial Contract length:** 3 months
* **Contract pay:** $60-80 per hour, paid every two weeks.
* **Full-time salary on conversion:** $65,000- $85,000 per year, based on location and experience.
* **Benefits after conversion:** Eligible for BRAINS’ full-time benefits, including health, dental, PTO, 401(k), etc.
* **How conversion works:** Near the end of the contract, we’ll review performance, fit, and business needs together. If it’s a match, we’ll extend a full-time offer. While conversion to full time is our intent, it isn’t guaranteed.

The client is seeking a Senior IT Program Manager to lead a complex, multi-year, multi-million dollar transformation program. The Senior IT Program Manager will own program-level planning, governance, financial management, dependency management, and benefits realization across these initiatives, from current state through production launch and transition to operations. The Senior IT Program Manager provides direction to the project managers, business analysts, and vendor delivery teams assigned to each initiative, serves as the primary escalation point below executive leadership, and is accountable for delivering the program on schedule, within scope, and within budget.

**Bilingual Intake Coordinator (English/Spanish)**  
Headstart Health | Fully Remote | Full-Time  
$55,000–$65,000 annually

Be the warm, welcoming first introduction to Headstart for families seeking autism care. You’ll help families feel heard, understand their next steps, and move through intake with personal, attentive support.

**Fluent spoken Spanish is required.** You’ll support families in both English and Spanish. We strongly prefer availability for a schedule of approximately **9 a.m.–6 p.m. Pacific Time or Mountain Time**.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* $55,000–$65,000 annual salary, based on relevant experience and qualifications.
* Fully remote, full-time position.
* Health-insurance reimbursement to help cover the cost of your coverage.
* Unlimited paid time off, coordinated with your manager to maintain team coverage.
* Close collaboration with the Lead Manager and operations team, with opportunities to develop your skills as Headstart grows.

**About Headstart Health**

Headstart Health helps Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) build and run independent autism-care practices. We support intake, credentialing, billing, and recruiting so clinicians can focus on providing care to children and families.

**About the Role**

You’ll guide families from their first conversation with Headstart through gathering records and preparing for insurance verification. You’ll answer questions, coordinate with referring offices, and keep next steps moving while making each interaction feel personal.

Working with our Lead Manager and Insurance Operations team, you’ll help resolve delays and prepare thoughtful handoffs. Families should know who to contact, understand what’s needed, and trust you to follow through.

**What You’ll Do**

* Welcome families, conduct scheduled intake calls, and follow up by phone, text, and email in English and Spanish.
* Listen to families’ questions, explain the intake process clearly, and keep them informed about next steps.
* Collect and track clinical, insurance, demographic, and intake documents; coordinate with families, referring offices, and schools to obtain missing records.
* Review referrals and faxes, document outreach and call outcomes, and maintain accurate Salesforce records.
* Help families complete portal setup and prepare organized handoffs to Insurance Operations.
* Flag stalled cases, time-sensitive needs, and complex questions to the Lead Manager, and suggest practical improvements to the family experience.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Required**

* Fluent spoken Spanish and strong English communication skills, including the ability to conduct a family intake conversation in either language.
* At least one year of experience in patient intake, care coordination, healthcare operations, or a similar frontline support role.
* A friendly, personable phone presence, strong listening skills, and comfort with frequent calls and outreach.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and dependable follow-through across multiple families at different stages of intake.
* Comfort using digital tools, learning new systems, and handling confidential patient information.
* The ability to work independently, ask thoughtful questions, and adapt as processes evolve.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on Salesforce experience is a significant plus, especially managing leads, documenting outreach, and using task queues or reports. Experience with another CRM is also helpful.
* Experience in ABA, behavioral health, or pediatric healthcare.
* Familiarity with insurance eligibility, benefits verification, or payer documentation requirements.
* Experience with Aircall or similar phone systems, virtual fax tools, and Google Workspace.

**What Success Looks Like**

Families experience you as friendly, welcoming, and dependable. You remember the details, follow up when promised, and keep them informed when something is delayed. Your records are current and your handoffs give teammates the context they need to continue that care.

**How to Apply**

Submit your résumé. You’re welcome to include a brief note about your experience and interest in Headstart, but it isn’t required.

Part of the interview process will be conducted in Spanish with a fluent Spanish-speaking member of our team to assess how clearly and warmly you communicate with families.

* Paid time off

Language:

We provide timely, scalable, evidence-based psychiatry and addiction care to individuals who

might otherwise face long wait times or significant travel barriers to receiving treatment.

* Team well-being
* Lower total cost of care

**Synapse Health | Who We Are**

Synapse exists to make DME simpler and more connected for everyone involved, from patients and providers to health plans and suppliers. Through our technology platform, we make sure patients receive the right product, at the right time, in the right amount. We've reached real scale, but there's still a lot left to build, which means the work here has visible impact, not incremental polish.

Since 2016, with decades of industry and leadership experience, we've delivered tech-based solutions that help our partners to modernize operations, improve coordination, and reduce administrative burdens. **What We Need****:**

The ***Workforce Management Real-Time Analyst*** owns intraday performance across our domestic and global contact center operations. Working closely with our WFM Analysts, operations leaders, and global partners, you will help protect the patient and provider experience while allowing frontline leaders to focus on coaching and developing their teams.

At Synapse Health, we've intentionally built a culture rooted in kindness, collaboration, and creativity, qualities we consider essential for every team member. Additional requirements include:

* Clear, direct, and respectful communication, including redirecting agents on adherence in real time.
* Availability to work between 8:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m. ET (Monday – Saturday coverage).
* Knowledge of durable medical equipment (DME) business strongly preferred.

* Analytical Problem Solver: Spots patterns in intraday data, troubleshoots issues quickly, and turns findings into practical actions.
* Calm Ownership: Makes sound decisions under pressure and follows every issue through to resolution.
* Detail-Oriented and Consistent: Keeps records accurate and applies guidelines the same way for every team.
* Adaptable and Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with change, quick to adopt new tools, and motivated by continuous improvement.
* Influence Without Authority: Earns trust with agents, leaders, and partner sites so real-time requests get acted on.

**Compensation:**

The pay range for this position is $20.38 – $25.50 per hour. This range reflects the anticipated compensation at the time of posting. Final compensation will be based on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, internal equity, and prevailing market conditions. Compensation discussions are encouraged throughout the hiring process.

jobs.title: RevOps Program Manager, Alliances & Partnerships
jobs.description:
**About Megaport**

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

**Our Team Culture**

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.

We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

### **The Role**

The RevOps Program Manager, Alliances & Partnerships is responsible for building, operating, measuring, and continuously improving the operational infrastructure that connects Megaport's partner ecosystem to its global go-to-market organization.

This role bridges Alliance Partner Operations, Revenue Operations, and cross-functional Program Management. It combines hands-on execution of partner referrals, co-sell opportunity management, partner-system administration, and pipeline alignment with ownership of the processes, reporting, governance, and improvement programs that make partner-driven revenue scalable and measurable.

The position serves as a central operational connection point between external alliance ecosystems and Megaport's internal Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product, Legal, Customer Success, and Revenue Technology teams. It ensures that partner-originated and partner-influenced opportunities are accurately captured, routed to the appropriate internal teams, actively maintained across relevant systems, and measured throughout the revenue lifecycle.

Working with Alliance Leadership and GTM executives, the role translates partner-program requirements into practical operating procedures, reliable data flows, clear accountability, and actionable business intelligence. It supports joint selling motions, cloud marketplace transactions, partner-funded investments, and ecosystem development by reducing operational friction and improving visibility into partner contribution.

The successful candidate is equally comfortable executing an urgent partner referral update, troubleshooting a cross-system data discrepancy, analyzing pipeline conversion, presenting program performance to executives, and leading a cross-functional initiative to improve the partner revenue engine.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

#### **Alliance Partner Operations & Lifecycle Management**

* Own day-to-day operational workflows supporting partner onboarding, program enrollment, tiering, enablement tracking, certification or eligibility tracking where applicable, and ongoing program compliance. Specifically with AWS ACE:

  + Inbound & Outbound motions: Salesforce Opptys with a Direct Connect component via ACE.
  + Own intake of AWS referrals, accept or reject within SLA, and route to the right seller.
  + AWS account team engagement acceptance and coordination of opportunity assignments.
* Administer and maintain Megaport's participation in relevant partner ecosystems, including partner profiles, program records, solution listings, sales contacts, and other required operational information.
* Coordinate partner-program renewals, requirements, submissions, and deadlines with Alliance Leadership and relevant internal stakeholders.
* Monitor partner-program health and identify operational gaps that could affect eligibility, referrals, co-selling participation, or commercial outcomes.
* Establish repeatable procedures for routine partner administration while identifying opportunities for automation and reduced manual effort.

#### **Referral Intake, Routing & Co-Sell Execution**

* Execute the intake, validation, registration, acceptance, updating, routing, and follow-through of partner referrals and co-sell opportunities within approved operating rules.
* Align incoming partner opportunities with the appropriate internal sales team, account owner, regional coverage, product portfolio, brand, and go-to-market motion.
* Coordinate with Direct Sales, Channel Sales, SDRs, Customer Success, and other relevant teams to confirm ownership, acceptance, next actions, and timely follow-through.
